Sar Ta Ba Qadam Hai Tane Sultane Zaman Phool Lab Phool Dahan Phool Zaqan Phool Badan Phool
Phir Ke Gali Gali Tabha Thokarien Sab Ki Khaaye Kyun Dil Ko Jo Aql De Khuda Teri Gali Se Jaaye Kyun

Pul Se Utaro Rah Guzar Ko Khabar Na Ho Jibreel Par Bichaaye To Par Ko Khabar Na Ho

Sunte Hain Ki Mehshar Me Sirf Unki Rasaai Hain Gar Unki Rasaai Hai Lo Jab To Ban Aayi Hain

Wasf E Rukh Unka Kiya Karte Hain Sharah E Wash Shams O Dhuha Karte Hain Unki Hum Madh O Sana Karte Hain Jinko Mehmood Kaha Karte Hain
Arsh E Haq Hai Masnad E Rifa’t Rasool Allah Ki Dekhni Hai Hashr Me Izzat Rasool Allah Ki
Sarwar Kahun Ke Malik O Maula Kahun Tujhe Baagh E Khaleel Ka Gul E Zaiba Kahun Tujhe
Zarre Jhar Kar Teri Paizaaro’n Ke Taj E Sar Bante Hain Saiyyaro’n Ke

sections.title: Peshe Haq Muzda Shafa'at Ka Sunate Jayengey Aap Rote Jayengey Hum Ko Hansaate Jayengey

blocks.text: Peshe Haq Muzda Shafa'at Ka Sunate Jayengey
Aap Rote Jayengey Hum Ko Hansaate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Peshe Haq = Allah Ke Saamne
2) Muzda = Khushkhabri
3) Shafa'at = Sifaarish

Mafhoom :-
Baroz E Qiyamat Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Khuda Ki
Bargah Me Humien Shafa'at Ka Muzda E Jaan Fiza
(Khushkhabri) Sunayengey. Dare Huwe Dilo'n Ko
Sukoon Aajega Phir Jab Ummat Sooye Jannat Rawaan
Hogi To Manzar Ye Hoga Ke Huzoor Khud To Rote
Hongey ( Ummat Ke Liye Allah Ki Bargah Me Rona)
Aur Ummat Ki Bakshish Ki Khushi Me Hansi Huyi
Ummat Jannat Ki Taraf Rawaan Dawaan Hogi.
Dil Nikal Jaane Ki Ja Hai Aah Kin Aankho'n Se
Woh
Hum Se Pyaaso'n Ke Liye Darya Bahate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Ja = Jagah
2) Hum Se = Humare Jaise
3) Bahana = Chalana

Mafhoom :-
Hamara Kaleja Phat Kyun Nahi Jaata ( Jab Ye
Manzoor Tasawwur Me Aaye) Ke Hamare Aaqa ﷺ
Hum Jaise Nikammo'n Ke Liye Apni Pyaari Aur
Sarmageen Aankhon Se Aansuon Ka Darya Baha Rahe
Hongey.
Kusthgaane Garmi E Mehshar Ko Wo Jaan E
Maseeh
Aaj Daaman Ki Hawaa De Kar Jilaate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Kushtgaane = Maqtool
2) Garmi E Mehshar = Qiyamat Ki Dhoop Aur Garmi
3)Jaan E Maseeh = Hazrath E Isa Alaihissalam Ki Jaan

Mafhoom :-
Allah! Allah! Mehshar Ki Qiyamat Ki Garmi Me
Jab Jism Jhalas Kar Murda Ho Chuke Hongey Wo Jaan
E Maseeh, Rehmat E Aalam ﷺ Apne Daaman E
Rehmat Ki Hawa De Kar Un Murdo'n Ko Zinda Farma
Rahe Hongey, Yaani Shafa'at Farma Kar Us Museebat
Se Chuda Rahe Hongey.
Gul Khile Ga Aaj Ye Un Ki Naseem E Faiz Se
Khoon Rote Aayengey Hum Muskurate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Naseem E Faiz = Bakhshish Ki Khushbudaar Hawa
2) Khoon Rona = Khoob Gid Gida Kar Rona

Mafhoom :-
Jab Aaqa Kareem ﷺ Ke Faiz O Karam Se
Thandi O Khushbudaar Hawa Chalegi To Murjaye
Huwe Chehre Phool Ki Tarah Khil Jayengey To Hum
Gunahgar Maidan E Mehshar Me Aaye To Khauf Ke
Maare Rote Rote Ab Jannat Ki Taraf Khoob
Khushiyaan Manate Ja Rahe Hain.
Haan Chalo Hasrat Zado'n Sunte Hain Wo Din Aaj
Hai
Thi Khabar Jiski Ke Wo Jalwa Dikhate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Hasrat Zada = Mehroom, Gham Ka Maara
2) Jalwa Dikhana = Deedar Karwana

Mafhoom :-
Aye Gham Ke Maaro! Aye Be Saharo! Jis Din
Ke Baare Me Hum Ne Padha Aur Tum Ne Suna Tha
Ke Huzoor ﷺ Ka Deedar Hoga, Chalo! Wo Din Aa
Gaya Hai Aur Wo Dekho Mehboob E Khuda Apne
Chehre Anwar Se Parda Hatane Aa Rahe Hain.
Aaj Eid E Aashiqaan Hain Gar Khuda Chahe Ke
Woh
Abru E Paywasta Ka Aalam Dikhate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Eid = Khushi Ka Din
2) Abru E Paywasta = Mile Huwe Bhavien

Mafhoom :-
Haan Haan Aaj Hi Aashiqan E Rasool Ki Asal
Eid Hai Ke Duniya Me To Bina Dekhe Un Ki Baatien
Karte The Aur Sunte The Aaj Zara Apni Aankhon Se
Mehboob E Khuda Ke Mile Huwe Bhanwein Mubarak
Dekho Aur Unki Bargah Me Mohabbat Ke Saath
Durood O Salam Ke Nazrane Pesh Karo.
Khaak Uftaado'n Bas Unke Aane Hi Ke Dair Hai
Khud Woh Gir Ka Sajda Me Tum Ko Utha Te
Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Khaak Uftaado'n = Zameen Par Gire Huwe Logon,
Majboor

Mafhoom :-
Aye Khaak Nasheeno! Ab Tumhien Khaak Se
Utha Kar Jannat Ke Baghaat Pahunchane Ka Waqt
Aagaya, Bas Unke Aane Hi Ki Dair Hai Ek Sajde
Karengey, Khud Sajde Me Tashreef Le Jayengey Aur
Tumhien Khaak Se Utha Kar Hamdosh Sara Karengey.
Kuch Khabar Bhi Hai Faqeero'n Aaj Wo Din Hai
Ke Woh
Ne'mat E Khuld Apne Sadqe Me Lutate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Ne'mat E Khuld = Jannat Ki Ne'mat

Mafhoom :-
Duniya Me To Aaqa ﷺ Jannat Ki
Basharatien Sunate Rahe Lekin Aaj Baroz E Mehshar
Apni Ummat Ko Jannat Ki Nemat Taqseem Farmate
Huwe Dikhayi Dengey.
Wusa'tien Dee Hain Khuda Ne Daaman E Mehboob
Ko
Jurm Khulte Jayengey Aur Woh Chupate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Wusa'tien = Kushaadgi, Gunjaishien

Mafhoom :-
Sarkar E Madina ﷺ Ke Daaman E Karam Ko
Allah Ne Itna Wasee' Farma Diya Hain Ke Hamare
Jitne Bhi Jurm Maidan E Mehshar Me Pesh Hongey
Sab Us Daaman E Rehmat Me Chup Jayengey.
Lo Woh Aaye Muskurate Hum Aseero'n Ki Taraf
Khirman E I'siyaan Pe Ab Bijli Giraate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Lo Woh Aaye = Kisi Ki Achanak Aamad Par Bola
Jaata Hai
2) Aseero'n = Qaidiyon
3) Khirman E I'siyaan = Gunaho'n Ka Dher
4) Bijli Girana = Barbaad Karna

Mafhoom :-
Aye Ahle Mehshar! Sab Khade Hojao! Wo
Dekho Aaqa ﷺKi Sawari Aagayi Aur Huzoor ﷺ
Apne Gunahgar Ummatiyo'n Ki Taraf Dekh Kar
Muskura Rahe Hain Aur Haan Tumhien Apne
Gunaho'n Ke Ambaar Nazar Aa Rahe Hain, Us Liye
Pareshan Ho? To Phir Khush Hojao Dekho Mere Aaqa
Kis Tarah Tumhare Gunaho'n Pe Apne Jamal Ki
Bijliyo'n Gira Kar Unko Jala Kar Raakh Kar Rahe
Hain.
Aankh Kholo Ghamzado'n Dekho Wo Giryaa'n
Aaye Hai
Loh Dil Se Naqsh E Gham Ke Ab Mitate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz:-

1) Aankh Kholo = Hosh Me Aajao!
2) Giryaa'n = Rona
3) Loh Dil = Dil Ki Takhti
4) Naqsh = Nishaan

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mujrimo! Hosh Me Aao! Wo Dekho
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ! Allah Ki Bargah Me Ro Ro Kar
Tumhare Gunaho'n Ki Nishaan Tak Tumahre Dil Ki
Takhti Se Mitaa Rahe Hain.
Sokhta Jaano'n Pe Wo Pur Josh E Rehmat Aaye
Hain
Aab E Kausar Se Lagi Dil Ki Mitate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Sokhta = Jala Huwa
2) Aab E Kausar = Houz E Kausar Ka Paani

Mafhoom :-
Aye Aasiyo'n! Tumhare Dilon Ko Agar
Gunaho'n Ki Aag Ne Jala Rakha Hai To Dekhte Nahi
Ho Ke Tumhare Aaqa ﷺ Ki Rehmat Ka Darya Bhi
Josh Me Aaya Huwa Hai, Wo Houz E Kausar Ke
Cheenton Se Tumhare Dilon Ko Lagi Huyi Aag
Bhujalengey.
Aaftab Unka Hi Chamkega Jab Auron Ke Chiraagh
Sar Sar E Josh E Balaa Se Jhilmilate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Aaftab = Suraj
2) Sar Sar = Aandhi
3) Jhilmilana = Chiragh Ka Thodi Thodi Roshni Dena

Mafhoom :-
Doosre Ambiya Kiram Ki Bhi Roshni Hogi
Magar Mehshar Ke Toofan Aalam O Masaib Ke
Aandhi Ki Wajah Se Bujhte, Jalte Hongey Lekin
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ka Suraj Us Waqt Joban Par Hoga.
Paaye Kubaan Pul Se Guzrengey Teri Awaaz Par
Rabbi Sallim Ki Sada Par Wajd Laate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Paaye Kubaan = Zor Se Paun Zameer Par Maarte
Huwe Pul Sirat Per Guzarna
2) Rabbi Sallim = Aye Allah! Salamati Ke Saath Meri
Ummat Ko Guzaar
3) Wajd = Jhoomna

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Pyaare Aaqa ﷺ Jab Aap Hum
Gunahgaron Ke Liye Pul Sirat Se Aasani Ke Saath
Guzarne Ke Kiye Apne Rab Se Dua Karnegey To Aap
Ki Aawaaz Sun Kar Hum Pul Se Zor Zor Se Qadam
Maarte Huwe Pul Se Guzar Jayengey.
Sarwar E Deen Lijiye Apne Naatwaano Ki Khabar
Nafs O Shaitaan Sayyada Kab Tak Dabaate
Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Sarwar E Deen = Deen Ke Sardar
2) Naatwaan = Kamzor
3) Sayyada = Aye Sardar

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mehboob ﷺ Meherbani Farmaye Aur
Humien Nafs O Shaitaan Ke Shar Se Bachaye. Aap Ke
Kamzor Ummati Ko Ye Zaalim Kab Tak Apna
Taabe'dar Bana Kar Hukm Chalate Rahengey.
Hashr Tak Daalenegey Hum Paidaish E Moula Ki
Dhoom
Misl E Faaras Najd Ke Qile' Giraate Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Paidaish = Huzoor ﷺ Ka Paida Hona
2) Dhoom = Charcha
3) Faaras = Iran

Mafhoom :-
Hum Apne Mehboob E Pak ﷺ Ke Milad Ke
Charche Karte Rahengey Aur Ye Silsila Qiyamat Tak
Jaari Rahega. Agar Najdi Ko Pasand Nahi Karta To
Jahannum Me Jaaye. Jaise Huzoor ﷺ Ke Paidaish
Huye Wo Iran Ke Mohallat Me Zalzala Aagaya Usi
Tarah Zikr E Milad Karte Rahengey Aur Najdi Qal'on
Ko Girate Jayengey.
Khaak Ho jayein A'duu Jal Kar Magar Hum To
Raza
Dam Me Jab Tak Dam Hai Zikr Unka Sunate
Jayengey
Mushkil Alfaz:-

1) Khaka Hojayien A'duu = Dushman Hasad Ki
Aag Me Jal Kar Rakh Hojaye
2) Dam Me Jab Tak Dam Hai = Jab Tak Jism Me
Jaan Hai

Mafhoom :-
Aye Dushmanan E Zikr E Mustafaﷺ Tum Jal
Kar Rakh Hojao Lekin Hamare Jism Me Jab Tak Jaan
Hai Hum Apne Aaqa ﷺ Ka Zikr Karte Hi Rahengey.

sections.title: Chamak Tujhse Paate Hain Sab Paane Waale Mera Dil Bhi Chamka De Chamkaane Waale

blocks.text: Chamak Tujhse Paate Hain Sab Paane Waale
Mera Dil Bhi Chamka De Chamkaane Waale
Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Chamak = Roshni, Nooraniyat

Mafhoom :-
Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ Jo Bhi Zamane Me Chamka
Hai Aap Hi Ke Noor Se Chamka Hai Kyun Ki Asl E
Kaayenat Aur Wajh E Takhleeq E Kaayenath Aap Hi
Hain, To Mere Aaqa ﷺ Mera Dil Bhi Gunaho'n Se
Siyah Ho Chuka Hain Is Par Bhi Noor Ki Ek Kiran
Daalde Taa Ke Ye Bhi Chamak Jaaye.
Barasta Nahi Dekh Kar Abre Rehmat
Bado'n Par Bhi Barsaade Barsaane Waale
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Barasta = Utarna, Naazil Hona
2) Abre Rehmat = Rehmat Ka Badal
3) Bado'n = Buro'n

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ Agarche Hamare Aamaal
Bohat Bure Sahin Shayad Unhe Dekh Kar Hi Rehmat
Ka Badal Hum Par Nahi Barasta To Aye Pyaare Nabi
ﷺ Aap Meherbaani Farmaye Aur Rehmat Ka Badal
Ko Hukm Dein Ke Hum Par Bhi Barse.
Madine Ki Khitte Khuda Tujhko Rakkhe
Ghareebo Faqeero'n Ke Tehraane Waale
Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Khitte = Tukde

Mafhoom :-
Aye Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ke Madine! Khuda Ta'ala
Tujhe Salamat Ta Qiyamat Rakhe Ke Hum Jaise
Ghareebo Faqeero'n Ko Tu Apna Thikana Ata Karne
Wala Hain.
Tu Zinda Hai Wallah Tu Zinda Hai Wallah
Mere Chashme Aalam Se Chhup Jaane Waale
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Wallah = Allah Ki Qasam
2) Chashme Aalam = Zaahiri Nazar

Mafhoom :-
Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ ! Allah Ki Qasam Aap Zinda
Hain Aur Hamari Zaahiri Nazar Se Poshida Hain.
Main Mujrim Hoon Aaqa Mujhe Saath Lelo
Ki Raaste Me Hain Ja Ba Ja Thaane Waale
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Mujrim = Gunhagar
2) Raaste = Raasta
3) Ja Ba Ja = Har Jagah
4) Thaane Waale = Thanvi Ke Maanne Waale, Chowk
Police Waale Yaani Allah Ke Firishtey

Mafhoom :-
Main Mujrim O Qusoorwaar Hoon Aur
Mujrimo'n Ke Peeche Har Waqt Police Waale Lage
Rehte Hain Usi Tarah Mere Peeche Allah Ke Firishtey
Lage Huwe Hain Mujhe Apni Panah Dijiye.
Haram Ki Zameen Aur Qadam Rakh Ke Chalna
Are Sar Ka Mauqa Hai O Jaane Waale
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Haram = Makka O Madina
2) Are = Nida Ke Liye Pukarna
3) Mauqa = Jaga

Mafhoom :-
Harmain Shareefain Ki Sarzameen To Itni
Muqaddas Hain Ke Bas Chale To Is Par Qadam Rakh
Kar Chalne Ki Bajaye Sar Ke Bal Chala Jaaye.
Chal Uth Jabah Farsa Ho Saaqi Ke Dar Per
Dar E Jood Aye Mere Mastaane Waale
Mushkil Alfaz:-

1) Jabah Farsa = Peshani Ragadne Waala
2) Saaqi = Pilane Waale
3) Jood = Sakhawat
4) Mastaane Waale = Ishq E Rasool ﷺ Me Mast
Rahne Waale

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ Ka Ishq Dil Me Rakhne
Waale! Chal Ja Sarkar Ki Bargah Me Dar E Rehmat
Khul Gaya Hai Aur Saaqi E Kausar Ka Faiz Jaari O
Saari Hai, Wahan Ja Kar Maatha Ragad Yaani Saare
Adab Bajaa La. Ya Matlab Ye Hain Ke Allah Ki
Bargah Me Sajda Shukrane Ke Nawafil Ada Kar Kyun
Ke Us Ne Tujhe Dar E Mustafa ﷺ Ki Haazri Se
Nawaza Aur Phir Sarkar Ki Bargha Me Aakar Qadmon
Me Gir Kar Faiz Maanga.
Tera Khaaye Tere Ghulamo'n Se Uljhe
Hain Munkir Ajab Khaane Ghurraane Waale
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Uljhein = Jhagdna
2) Munkir Ajab = Ajeeb Inkari
3) Ghurrana = Bila Waja Gusse Me Shor Karna

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ! Ye Aap Ki
Azmat Ke Munkireen Bhi Ajeeb Nasl Ke Log Hain Ke
Aap Ka Sadqa Khaate Hain Aur Aap Ke Hi Ghulamo'n
Se Ulajhte Hain.
Rahega Yunhi Unka Charcha Rahega
Pade Khaak Hojaaye Jal Jaane Waale
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Charcha = Shor, Dhoom, Zikr
2) Khaak Hojaaye = Mar Jaayien

Mafhoom :-
Aye Munkiron Tum Sarkar Ka Zikr Sun Kar Jalo
Ya Jal Jal Kar Maro Kyun Ke Huzoor ﷺ Ki Azmat
Ke Danke Bajte Hi Rahengey.
Ab Aayi Shafa'at Ki Saa'at Ab Aayi
Zara Chain Le Mere Ghabraane Waale
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Saa'at = Ghadi, Waqt
2) Chain = Aaram

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Dil! Kyun Ghabraate Ho
Abhi Tumhari Shafa'at Ki Baari Ab Aane Hi Waali
Hai.
Raza Nafs Dushman Hai Dam Me Na Aana
Kahan Tumne Dekhe Hain Chandraane Waale
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Dam Me = Dhoke Me
2) Chandraane Waale = Jhutlana

Mafhoom :-
Aye Ahmed Raza! Nafs Ke Dhoke Aur Fareb Me
Na Aana Tu Ne Abhi Behkane Waale Aur Phislaane
Waale Dekhe Hi Kahan Hai Aur Tu Kya Jaane Ke Wo
Kis Tarah Tere Imaan Par Hamla Aawar Hokar Tera
Kitna Nuqsaan Kar Jaate Hain.

sections.title: Ne'matien Bant Ta Jis Simt Wo Zeeshan Gaya Saath Hi Munshi E Rehmat Ka Qalamdaan Gaya

blocks.text: Ne'matien Bant Ta Jis Simt Wo Zeeshan Gaya
Saath Hi Munshi E Rehmat Ka Qalamdaan Gaya
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Ne'matien = Ataayien' Bakshishien
2) Bant Ta = Taqseem Karta
3) Zeeshan = Izzat O Shaan Wala
4) Munshi E Rehmat = Rehmat Ka Paida Karne Waala
( Allah Ta'ala)
5) Qalamdan = Qalam Daawat Ka Dabba

Mafhoom :-
Hamare Azmat O Shaan Waale Aaqa ﷺ Jis
Taraf Bhi Chal Pade Rehmat Ka Likhne Waala
Farishta Bhi Apna Qalam Dan Le Kar Aap Ke Saath
Ho Liya, Ke Kya Maloom Achansk Kis Ke Liye Kya
Rehmat Likhne Ka Hukm Ajaaye.
Le Khabar Jald Ke Ghairon Ki Taraf Dhyaan Gaya
Mere Moula Mere Aaqa Tere Qurbaan Gaya
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Le Khabar = Madad Kar
2) Ghair = Begana
3) Tere Qurbaan = Tere Sadqe

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Dastageer Aaqa ﷺ Meri Madad Jaldi
Farmaye Kyun Ke Mera Nafs Mujhe Ghalat Raaste Par
Na Daal De Aur Mujhe Barbaad Na Karde.
Aah Woh Aankh Ke Nakaam E Tamanna Hi Rahi
Haaye Wo Dil Jo Tere Dar Se Pur Armaan Gaya
Mushkil Alfaz:-

1) Aah = Haaye
2) Nakaam Tamanna = Jiski Tamanna Poori Na Ho
Sake
3) Pur Armaan = Tamannao'n Aur Armaano'n Se
Bhara Huwa

Mafhoom :-
Haaye! Afsos Meri Aankh Aap Ke Deedar Ki
Tamanna Se Poori Tarah Lutf Andaaz Bhi Na Ho Saki
Aur Mere Dil Ke Armaan Bhi Abhi Poore Na Huwe
Ke Waapsi Bhi Hogyi.
Dil Hai Wo Dil Jo Teri Yaad Se Ma'moor Raha
Sar Hai Wo Sar Jo Tere Qadmo'n Pe Qurbaan
Gaya
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Ma'moor = Abaad
2) Qurbaan = Nisaar

Mafhoom :-
Dil Wahi Hai Jo Pyare Mehboob ﷺ Ki Yaad Me
Basi Rahe Aur Sar Wahi Hai Jo Aaqa ﷺ Qadmo'n Pe
Qurbaan Hone Ke Jazbaat Apne Andar Rakhta Ho.
Unhien Jaana Unhien Maana Na Rakkha Ghair Se
Kaam
Lillahil Hamd Me Duniya Se Musalmaan Gaya

Mafhoom :-
Hum To Sirf Huzoor ﷺ Ko Hi Jaante Hain Aur
Maante Hain Humien Ghair Se Kya Kaam
Alhamdulillah Isi Aqeede Par Qayim Rah Kar Duniya
Se Musalmaam Hokar Ja Raha Hoon.
Aur Tum Par Mere Aaqa Ki Inaayat Na Sahi
Najdiyo'n Kalma Padhane Ka Bhi Ehsaan Gaya
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Inayath = Karam
2) Najdiyo'n = Ibn E Abdul Wahab Najdi Ke
Pairokaro, Huzoor ﷺ Ki Shaan Ke Munkiro'n

Mafhoom :-
Aye Shaan E Risalat Ke Munkir Najdiyo'n
Chalo Maan Liya Ke Mere Sarkar Ne Tumhare Upar
Koi Ehsan Nahi Farmaya Lekin Ye Jo Kalma Padh
Rahe Hi Ye To Tum Bhi Jaante Ho Huzoor ﷺ Ne
Diya Hai.
Aaj Le Unki Panah Aaj Madad Maang Unse
Phir Na Maanengey Qiyamat Me Agar Maan Gaya
Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Panah = Sahara

Mafhoom :-
Aye Munkir! Agar Qiyamat Me Khuda Ke Azaab
Se Bachna Chahte Ho To Aajao Aaj Hi Unke Daaman
E Karam Me Panah Lo Aur Agar Aaj Panah Na Li Aur
Apne Gande Aqeede Se Tauba Na Ki To Kal Apni
Aankhon Ke Saamne Maidan E Mehshar Me Huzoor
ﷺ Ki Shaan O Azmath Jab Dekhogey To Phir Zaroor
Maan Jaogey Lekin Wo Maan Na Kaam Na Aayega.
Uff Re Munkir Ye Bada Josh E Ta'ssub Aakhir
Bheed Me Haath Se Kam Bakht Ke Emaan Gaya
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Uff = Afsos Ka Kalma
2) Ta'ssub = Be Ja Kisi Ki Tarafdaari
3) Bheed = Hujoom
4) Kam Bakht = Bad Naseeb

Mafhoom :-
Aye Munkir Ye Bada Josh Ka Dusro Ki Taraf
Daari Kar Raha Hai Aur Gustakhiyaan Kar Raha Hain
, Afsos Ke Is Bheed Me Is Badbakht Ka Usi Ke Haath
Se Emaan Chala Gaya.
Jaan O Dil Hosh O Khirad Sab To Madine
Pahunche
Tum Ne Nahi Chalte Raza Saara To Saaman Gaya
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Khirad = Aqal
2) Saara Saaman = Sab Kuch

Mafhoom :-
Aye Raza! Tu Bhi Ajeeb Tarah Ka Aadmi Hai
Ke Teri Rooh, Teri Jaan, Tera Dil To Tasawwur E Taib
Ki Wajah Se Madina Pahunch Gaya Aur Tu Yahan
Baitha Hain.

sections.title: Sar Ta Ba Qadam Hai Tane Sultane Zaman Phool Lab Phool Dahan Phool Zaqan Phool Badan Phool

blocks.text: Sar Ta Ba Qadam Hai Tane Sultane Zaman Phool
Lab Phool Dahan Phool Zaqan Phool Badan Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Sar Ta Ba Qadam = Sar Se Lekar Paun Tk
2) Tan = Jism
3) Sultan E Zaman = Zamana Ka Badshah
4)Lab = Hont
5) Dahan = Munh
6) Zaqan = Thuddi
7) Badan = Jism

Mafhoom :-
Tajdaar E Zamana ﷺ Sar E Anwar Se Lekar
Qadam Tak Phool ( Latafat Waale) Hain, Hont, Munh,
Thuddi, Aur Saara Jism Goya Phool Hain.
Sadqe Me Tere Bagh To Kya Laaye Ban Phool
Is Ghuncha E Dil Ko Bhi Emaa Ho Ke Ban Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Ban = Jangal Aur Usme Khud Ro Darakht
Ban 2 = Banna Se Hain Yaani Hoja
Emaa = Ishara

Mafhoom :-
Huzoor ﷺ Aap Ke Tufail Sirf Baaghon Me Hi
Phool Nahi Khile Balke Jangal Ke Khud Ro Darakhto
Par Bhi Bahaar Aayi Hai Aur Un Pe Bhi Phool Khile
Hain. Nigah E Karam Farmaye Aur Mere Dil Ki Kali
Ko Bhi Apni Mohabbat Me Phool Bana Dijiye.
Tinka Bhi Humare To Hilaaye Nahi Hilta
Tum Chaho To Ho Jaaye Abhi Kohe Mihan Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Tinka = Mamooli Cheez
2) Koh = Pahad
3) Mihan = Ranj O Alam

Mafhoom :-
Hum Ek Tink Bhi Hilanae Ki Taqat Nahi Rakhte
Aur Mere Aaqa ﷺ Agar Chahe To Ghamon Ke Pahad
Bhi Phoolon Ki Tarah Narm O Nazuk Hojaaye.
Wallah Jo Mal Jaaye Mere Gul Ka Paseena
Mange Na Kabhi Itr Na Phir Chahe Dulhan Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

1) Wallah = Allah Ki Qasam
2) Mere Gul = Mere Mehboob

Mafhoom :-
Khuda Ki Qasam Agar Shaadi Ke Waqt Kisi
Dulhan Ko Huzoor ﷺ Ka Paseena Mal Jaaye To Wo
Kabhi Kisi Khushboo Ki Talab O Khwaish Na Rakhe
Aur Na Hi Kisi Phool Ki Talash Kare.
Dil Basta O Khoon Gashta Na Khusboo Na Lataafat
Kyun Ghuncha Kahun Hain Mere Aaqa Ka Dahan
Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Basta = Bandha Huwa
Gashta = Hona
Lataafat = Narmi, Khoobi

Mafhoom :-
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Dahan Mubarak Ghuncha
Nahi Kyun Ke Ghuncha To Band Hota Hai Aur
Huzoor ﷺ Se Har Waqt Phool Jhadte Rehte Hain.
Shab Yaad Thi Kin Daanto'n Ki Shabnam Ke Dam
E Subah
Shokhan E Bahaari Ke Juraoo Hain Kiran Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Dam E Subah = Subah Ke Waqt
Shokhan E Bahaari = Phoolon Ka Nikalne Ka Mausam
Jab Wo Nikalte Hain
Kiran = Suraj Ki Kiran

Mafhoom :-
Jin Daanto'n Ko Raat Ki Tanhaai Me Yaad Kar
Raha Tha To Aise Lagta Tha Ke Shabnam Hai Jo Ba
Waqt E Subah Suraj Ki Kiran Padhne Se Chamak Rahi
Thi.
Hazrath E Ali Farmate Hain Huzoor ﷺ Ke
Daant Mubarak Nihaayat Hi Chamakdaar The.
Dandaan O Lab O Zulf O Rukh E Shah Ke Fidaayi
Hain Durr E A'dan , La'al E Yaman,Mushk E
Khutan Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Dandaan = Daant
Shah = Baadshah Yaani Huzoor ﷺ
Fidaayi = Aashiq
Durr E A'dan = Adan Ke Mo'ti
La'al E Yaman = Yaman Ke Surkh La'al
Mushk E Khutan = Khalis Kastoori

Mafhoom :-
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Wo Hain Ke Jinke Dandaan E
Mubarak Pe Adan Ke Moti Nisaar, Labhaaye Mubarak
Pe Surkh Rang Ke Heere Qurbaan, Zulf E Muambar
Par Kastoori Fida Aur Chehra E Munawwar Par Phool
Jaan Chidakte Hain.
Boo Ho Ke Nihaan Hogaye Taab E Rukh E Shah
Me
Lo Ban Gaye Hain Ab To Haseeno Ke Dahan Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Boo = Mehak
Nihaan = Posheeda
Taab = Chamak
Dahan = Munh

Mafhoom :-
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ki Bargh Me
Tamam Haseenane Aalam Ke Husn O Jamal Gum
Hokar Rah Gaye Aur Unke Dahan Munh Jo Apni
Jagah Phool Ki Tarah Mehak Rahe The Jab Mehboob
E Khuda Ka Noorani Chehre Ke Saamne Aaye To
Mehak Ke Bajaye Garam Hawa Lo Ka Manzar Pesh
Karte Dikhaayi Dene Lage.
Ho’n Baar E Gunah Se Na Khajal Dosh E
Azeezaan
Lillah Meri Na'ash Kar Aye Jaan E Chaman Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Baar = Bojh
Khajal = Sharminda
Dosh = Kandha
Azeezaan = Rishtedaar
Lillah = Allah Ke Liye
Na'ash = Murda Jism
Jaan E Chaman = Baagh Ki Rooh

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Pyare Nabi ﷺ Karam Farma Kar
Meri Laash Ko Phoolon Ki Tarah Halka Phalka
Kardijiye Ke Mere Rishtedaar Meri Laash Utha Kar
Thak Na Jaayien Aur Wazni Laash Ko Mere Gunahon
Par Mehmool Kar Ke Sharminda Na Hote Phire.
Dil Apna Bhi Shaidaayi Hai Us Naakhun E Paa Ka
Itna Bhi Mah E Nau Pe Na Aye Charkh E Kohan
Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Shaidaayi = Fidaayi
Mah E Nau = Ibtedaayi Dino Ka Chand
Charkh E Kohan = Budha Aasmaan
Phool Aakhri = Phoolna

Mafhoom :-
Aye Budhe Aasmaan Jab Tere Upar Naya
Chanad Nikalta Hai To Tu Itrata Hai Aur Phoole Nahi
Samata, To Dekhta Nahi Ke Mere Mehboob ﷺ Ke
Paun Mubarak Ki Ungli Ka Ek Naakhun Tere Chand
Se Zyada Apne Andar Kashish Rakhta Hai.
Dil Khol Ke Khoon Ro Le Gham E Aariz E Shah
Me
Nikle To Kahin Hasrat E Khoon Na Ba Shadan
Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Dil Khol Ke Khoon Role = Poori Hasrat Nikal
Gham E Aariz = Aane Waala Gham
Hasrat = Afsos
Khoon Na Ba = Aansoo
Shadan = Hona

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Aankho! Anqareeb Tumhien Madine
Ki Baharien Chod Kar Yahan Se Chala Jaan Hai To
Aane Waali Judaayi Par Abhi Khoon Ke Aanso Ro Lo
Taa Ke Ye Khooni Aansoo Phool Ban Kar Tumhare
Dil Ki Hasrat Ko Poora Aur Judaayi Ke Gham Ko
Halka Karde.
Kya Ghaazah Mila Gard E Madina Ka Jo Hay Aaj
Nikhre Huye Joban Me Qiyamat Ki Phaban Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Ghaazah = Khusboodar Powder
Gard = Ghubaar, Mitthi
Nikhre Huye = Saaf Suthre
Joban = Jawani Ki Talash
Phaban = Khoobsurti

Mafhoom :-
Aye Phoolon! Aaj Tumhara Husn
Itne Shabab Par Kyun Nazar Aa Rahi Hai? Kya
Tumhien Aaj Ghubar E Madina Haath Nahi Aa Gaya
Jis Ko Tum Ne Chehro Par Bataur E Powder Ke Mal
Liya Hain.
Garmi E Qiyamat Hai Ke Kaante Hai Badan Par
Bulbul Ko Bhi Aye Saaqi Sehba O Laban Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Saaqi = Pilaane Waala
Sehba = Safed Angoor Ki Surkh Sharab
Laban = Doodh

Mafhoom :-
Qiyamat Ki Garmi Se Jab Zabaanien Sukh Kar
Kaanto Ki Tarah Hojayengey To Aye Mere Saaqi !
Apne Ghulamo Ko Jaam E Kausar Pilaa Kar Hamari
Pyaas Bhujayiye.
Hain Kon Ke Girya Kare Ya Fatiha Ko Aaye
Bekas Ko Uthaaye Teri Rehmat Ke Bharan Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Girya = Rona
Fatiha = Esal E Sawab
Be Kas = Mohtaj
Bharan = Tez Baarish

Mafhoom :-
Kon Hai Jo Mujh Ghareeb Ki Qabr Par Aa Kar
Royega Aur Kuch Padh Kar Esal E Sawab Kare Ga
Kaash! Ke Aye Mere Aaqa Aap Ka Koi Ghulam Aap
Ke Rehmat Ka Zikr Kare Aur Aap Ki Rehmat Ki Tez
Baarish Phool Ban Kar Mere Gunaho Ka Khatima
Karde.
Dil Gham Tujhe Ghere Hain Khuda Tujhko Wo
Chamaakye
Suraj Tere Khirman Ko Bane Teri Kiran Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Ghere Hain = Ihata Kiye Huwe Hain
Khirman = Dher

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Dukhi Dil Tujhe Gham Ne Kis Qadar
Ghera Hai Khuda Kare Tujhe Wasl E Mehboob Ke
Noor Ki Ek Chamak Mil Jaaye Madina Ki Haazri
Naseeb Hojaaye Agarche Kuch Lamho Ke Liye
Ziyarat E Mustafa ﷺ Hojaaye Agarcha Khwaab Me
Hi Sahi To Tere Dil Se Noor Ke Aise Chashme
Phootengey Ke Suraj Bhi Un Nooro'n Ki Kiran Nazar
Aayega.
Kya Baat Raza Us Chamanistan E Karam Ki
Zahra Hai Kali Jis Me Hussain Aur Hasan Phool
Mushkil Alfaz :-
Chamanistan = Baagh

Mafhoom :-
Aye Raza Us Baagh Ki Kya Baat Hai Jis Bagh E
Risalat Ki Kali Sayyada Fatima Hai Aur Hasan Aur
Hussain Us Baagh Ke Mehakte Huwe Phool Hain.

sections.title: Phir Ke Gali Gali Tabha Thokarien Sab Ki Khaaye Kyun Dil Ko Jo Aql De Khuda Teri Gali Se Jaaye Kyun

blocks.text: Phir Ke Gali Gali Tabha Thokarien Sab Ki Khaaye
Kyun
Dil Ko Jo Aql De Khuda Teri Gali Se Jaaye Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Tabah = Weeran
Sab Ki = Tamam Logon Ki

Mafhoom :-
Duniyavi Mohabbaton Me Mubtila Hokar Hum
Gali Gali Zaleel Hote Kyun Phirein Allah Ta'ala
Hamare Dil Ko Agar Aqal Ata Karde To Habeeb E
Khuda ﷺ Ki Gali Me Aisa Dera Lagaaye Phir Wahan
Se Janaza Hi Uthe.
Rukhsat E Qafila Ka Shor Ghash Se Humien
Uthaaye Kyun
Sote Hain Unke Saaye Me Koi Humein Jagaaye
Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Rukhsat = Rawangi
Qafila = Musafiron Ka Giroh, Group
Ghash = Be Hoshi
Saaye = Panah

Mafhoom :-
Qafila Ki Madina E Munawwara Se Rawangi Ka
Shor O Ghul Hamari Sukoon Ki Neend Me Khalal
Andaaz Kyun Kar Ho Sakta Hai Kyun Ke Hum To
Mehboob Ke Dar Par Unke Saaye Me Panah Le Kar
Chain Ki Neend So Rahe Hai.
Baar Na The Habeeb Ko Paalte Hi Ghareeb Ko
Royien Jo Ab Naseeb Ko Chain Kaho Ganwaaye
Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Baar = Bojh
Ghareeb = Kangaal, Pardesi
Chain = Aaram

Mafhoom :-
Hamare Aaqa O Maula ﷺ To Ghareeb Parwar
Wa Banda Nawaz Hai Agar Hum Apni Qismat Ki
Wajah Se Saari Zindagi Madina Shareef Me Nahi
Guzaar Sakte Aur Waapis Aa Kar Madina Chod Kar
Be Sukoon Ki Zindagi Guzar Rahe Hain To Iska
Matlab Ye Nahi Ke Hum Huzoorﷺ Par Bojh Bane
Huwe The Aur Unho Ne Humien Wahan Se Nikal
Diya.
Yaad E Huzoor Ki Qasam Ghaflat E A'ish Hai
Sitam
Khoob Hai Qaid E Gham Me Hum Koi Humien
Churraaye Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Ghaflat = La Parwahi
Aish = Aaram O Sukoon
Sitam = Zulm
Khoob = Accha
Qaid = Giraftaar
Churraaye = Azaad Karaye

Mafhoom :-
Aye Hamare Pyaare Aaqa ﷺ Apni Ummat Ko
Yaad Karke Jo Aap Khoob Roya Karte The Aur Un Ki
Bakhshish Ke Liye Allah Se Duaien Maanga Karte
The Us Yaadgari E Ummat Ki Qasam! Humien Aap
Ko Yaad Karte Rehna Chahiye Wisal Ki Khushi Me
Chahe Judaayi Ki Tadap Me Isi Me Sukoon Hai Agar
Koi Is Ko Qaid Samajhta Hai To Hum Ye Qaidi Hi
Acche Hain Kisi Se Is Se Azaadi Nahi Maangte. Jab
Ke Aap Ke Yaad Se Ghafil Hojana Zulm Se Kam Nahi
Ke Ummati Hokar Apne Nabi Se Ghafil Hojaaye.
Dekh Ke Hazrath E Ghani Phail Pade Faqeer Bhi
Chaayi Hai Ab To Chaaoni Hashr Hi Aa Na Jaaye
Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Hazrath = Buzurg
Ghani = Maaldar
Chaaoni = Chatri

Mafhoom :-
Huzoor ﷺ Ka Jood O Sakhawat Dekh Kar
Maangne Waale Is Tarah Aap Ki Baragah E Aqdas Me
Jama Hogaye Ke Aisa Lagta Hai Jaise Inhone Yahan
Dere Bhicha Liye Hain Aur Qiyamat Bhi Aajaye To
Yahan Se Uthne Ka Naam Nahi Lengey.
Jaan Hai Ishq E Mustafa Roz Fazoo Kare Khuda
Jisko Ho Dard Ka Maza Naaz E Dawa Uthaaye
Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Fazoo = Zyaada
Dard = Takleef
Naaz E Dawa = Ilaj Ka Nakhra

Mafhoom :-
Aaqa E Do Jahaan ﷺ Ki Mohabbat Hamari Jaan
Hai, Allah Ta'ala Is Me Barkat Paida Farmaye Baaqi
Raha Unki Mohabbat Me Rona Aur Aanso Bahana Ye
Aisa Dard Hai Ke Jiska Hum Ilaj Karna Hi Nahi
Chahte Kyun Ke Jis Ko Dard Me Maza Aagaya Wo
Ilaja Kyun Karega.
Hum To Hain Aap Dil Figaar Gham Me Hansi Hi
Na Gawaar
Ched Ke Gul Ko Nau Bahaar Khoon Humein
Rulaaye Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Aap = Khud Hi
Dil Figaar = Zakhmi Dil
Na Gawar = Na Munasib
Nau Bahar = Mausam E Bahar

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mausam E Bahaar! Hum To Pehle Hi Apne
Mehboob Ke Hijr O Firaq Me Dil Zakhmi Kiye Baithe
Hai Aur Ghamgheen Ki Halat Me Bhala Hansi Koi
Accha Lagta Hain? Lihaza Phoolon Ko Ched Kar
Hamare Gham Me Mazeed Izafa Kar Ke Humien
Khoon Ke Aansoo Na Rula.
Yaa To Yunhi Tadap Ke Jaayien Ya Wahi Daam Se
Churaayien
Minnat E Ghair Kyun Uthayien Koi Taras Jataaye
Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Tadap = Bechain
Daam = Jaal
Taras = Hamdardi
Jatana = Zaahir Karna

Mafhoom :-
Jis Qaid ( Hijr O Firaq E Rasool ﷺ) Me Hum
Phans Chuke Hain Is Se Rihaayi Ki Ilteja Auron Se
Karke Hum Kyun Kar Uska Ehsan Apne Sar Par Le
Aur Na Hi Hamare Saath Hamdardi Karne Ki Zaroorat
Nahi Bas Wahi Hamare Aaqa Humien Churaayengey
Jalwa Dikhaayengey To Hijr Ke Qaid Se Rihaayi
Paayengey Warna Is Qaid Me Tadap Kar Unke Liye
Jaan Qurban Kardengey.
Unke Jalal Ka Asar Dil Se Lagaye Hain Qamar
Jo Ke Ho Laut Zakhm Par Daagh E Jigar Mitaaye
Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Jalal = Shaan O Shaukat
Qamar = Chand
Laut = Shaidaayi
Daagh = Nishaan

Mafhoom :-
Chand Pe Siyah Kaala Dhabba
Mere Aaqa ﷺ Ke Ro'ab O Jalal Ka Nishaan Hai Lekin
Wo Is Ko Mitaana Nahi Chahta Kyun Ke Jis Ko Ishq
E Rasool Me Zakhm Kha Kar Maza Aaye Wo Un
Zakhmo Ka Ilaaj Kyun Kare.
Khush Rahe Gul Pe Andaleeb Khaare Haram
Mujhe Naseeb
Meri Balaa Bhi Zikr Per Phool Ke Khaar Khaaye
Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Andaleeb = Bulbul
Khaare Haram = Madine Ka Kaanta
Balaa = Museebat
Phool = Phoolna Yaani Takabbur Karna

Mafhoom :-
Aye Bulbul Tujhe Phool Mubarak Ho Aur Mujhe
Tere Upar Na Rashk Aata Hai Na Mai Tujh Pe Hasad
Karta Hoon Is Liye Ke Agar Tujhe Kisi Baagh Ka
Phool Naseeb Hai Mujhe To Madina Ka Kaanta
Milgaya Hai Aur Madine Ka Ek Kaanta Tere Hazaar
Phoolon Se Afzal Hai Kyun Ke Wo Shehr E Mehboob
Ka Kaanta Hai Aur Waise Bhi Gulo'n Se Khaar Behtar
Hai Jo Daaman Thaam Lete Hain.
Gard E Malaal Agar Dhule Dil Ki Kali Agar Khile
Barq Se Aankh Kyun Jale Rone Pe Muskuraaye
Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Gard E Malaal = Gham Ka Ghubaar
Kali = Ghuncha
Barq = Bijli
Jale = Sadna

Mafhoom :-
Khuda Kare Ke Gham Ka Gard O Ghubaar Ishq
E Rasool Ke Paani Se Dhul Jaaye Aur Dil Ki Kali
Nigah E Mustafa Se Khil Jaaye To Phir Meri Aankh
Ko Bijli Bhi Na Jala Sake Gi Kyun Ke Aankh Ki
Roshni Bijli Se Bhi Tez Hojaaye Gi Aur Phir Meri
Khushi Ke Aanso Pe Koi Hans Bhi Na Sake Ga Ke Har
Kisi Ko Mera Haal Maloom Hoga Aur Har Koi Allah
Se Ro Ro Kar Mere Jaisa Haal Talab Kare Ga.
Jaan E Safar Naseeb Ko Kis Ne Kaha Maze Se So
Khatka Agar Sehar Ka Ho Shaam Se Mout Aaye
Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Naseeb = Muqaddar
Maze Se So = Aaram Ki Neend
Khatka = Khauf, Darr

Mafhoom :-
Madina Shareef Jaise Safar Ki Tayyari Kar Ke
Maze Ki Neend So Jaane Ka Kya Matlab! Agar Subah
Bedar Hone Ka Khatra Tere Peshe Nazar Tha To Tujhe
Shaamo'n Shaam Is Tarah Maut ( Neend) Na Aati
Balke Madine Ki Yaad Me Raat Bhar Jaag Kar Guzar
Jaata.
Ab To Na Rok Aye Ghani Aa'dat E Sag Bigad Gayi
Mere Kareem Pehle Hi Luqma E Tar Khilaaye
Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Ghani = Maaldaar
Luqma E Tar = Tar Niwala

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Kareem Aaqa ﷺ Aap Ki Rehmat Ki
Wusa'ton Ko Dekh Kar Aap Ke Jood O Ata Ki
Bulandiyon Ko Dekh Kar Aur Musalsal Aap Ki
Ataaien Samet , Samet Kar Aap Ki Gali Ke Is Sag Ki
Aadat Bigad Gayi Hain Agar Baad Me Rukhi Sokhi
Roti Par Guzara Karwana Tha To Pehle Hi Tar Niwala
Khilaya Hota, Ab Meherbani Farmaye Karam Ki
Bheek Ata Karte Rahe Taa Ke Ek Hi Dagar Pe Guzarti
Rahe Aur Ameeri Ke Baad Faqeeri Ka Munh Na
Dekhna Pade.
Raah E Nabi Me Kya Kami Farsh Biyaadh E
Deedah Ki
Chadar E Zil Mulgaji Zere Qadam Bhichaaye Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Farsh = Qaleen Waghaira, Zameen
Biyaadh E Deedah = Aankh Ki Safedi
Zil = Saaya
Mulgaji = Ghubaar, Aaluda
Zere Qadam = Qadam Ke Neeche

Mafhoom :-
Huzoor E Aqdas ﷺ Ke Jism Ka Saaya Na Hone
Ki Ek Aqli Wajah Bayan Farmate Hain Ke Aap Ki
Guzar Gaah Pe Apni Aankhon Ki Safedi Ka Farsh
Bhichaane Waale Aap Ke Ghulamo'n Ki Kya Kami
Hai Jo Aap Ko Saaya Ki Maili Kuchli Chadar Mehsoos
Ho.
Sang E Dar E Huzoor Se Hum Ko Khuda Na Sabr
De
Jaana Hai Sar Ko Jaa Chuke Dil Ko Qaraar Aaye
Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Sang = Chowkat
Qaraar = Sukoon

Mafhoom :-
Aye Allah Meri Ye Dua Ke Tere Mehboob Ke
Dar Par Bechain Hokar Zindagi Guzarun, Aur Sar
Rakh Kar Ragdun Ya Phir Beqaraari me jaan bhi de
dun lekin Qaraar kaise aaye.
Hai To Raza Nira Sitam Jurm Pe Gar Lajaayein
Hum
Koi Bajaaye Soz E Gham Saaz E Tarab Bajaaye
Kyun
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Nira = Khalis
Sitam = Zulm
Jurm = Gunah
Lajaaye = Sharmaye
Soz E Gham = Gham Ki Jalan
Saaz E Tarab = Khushi Ka Saaz Baja

Mafhoom :-
Aye Raza Kis Qadar Zulm Hoga
Ke Hum Apne Gunaho Par Sharminda Ho Kar Ro Ro
Kar Allah Se Muafi Maang Rahe Ho Aur Koi Hamare
Gham Me Shareek Ho Kar Hamdardi Karke Pareshaan
Hone Ke Bajaaye Khushi Aur Masrrat Ke Shaadiyaane
Bajana Shuru Karde. To Jan Ye Kisi Mamooli Samjh
Boojh Waale Se Nahi Ho Sakta To Hamare Aaqa
Humien Sazao'n Me Dekh Kar Kaise Khush Rahengey
Balke Unko To Khushi Tab Hogi Jab Saare Ummati
Jannat Me Daakhil Hojayengey.

sections.title: Unki Mehak Ne Dil Ke Ghunche Khila Diya Hain Jis Raah Chal Gaye Hain Kooche Basa Diye Hain

blocks.text: Unki Mehak Ne Dil Ke Ghunche Khila Diya Hain
Jis Raah Chal Gaye Hain Kooche Basa Diye Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Mehak = Bheeni Bheeni Khushboo
Ghunche = Kali, Band Phool
Khila Diye = Khol Diye Hain
Kooche = Galiyaan
Basa Diye = Abaad Kardiye

Mafhoom :-
Mere Aaqa ﷺ Ki Kaisi Shaan Hai Ke Aap
Jidhar Se Bhi Guzre Hain Aap Ke Jism E Aqdas Ke
Khushboo Se Dilo Ki Band Kaliyaan Khilti Gayi (
Gham Mit Gaye, Mohabbat Ki Hawaien Chalti Gayi)
Aur Gali Koocho'n Se Weerani Door Hogayi Aur
Aabdai Hogayi.
Jab Aagayi Hai Josh E Rehmat Pe Unki Aankhien
Jalte Bujha Diye Hain Rote Hansa Diya Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Josh = Ghalba
Jalne = Jo Aag Me Jal Raha Ho

Mafhoom :-
Mere Aaqa Ki Rehmat Ka Aalam Ye Hai Ke Jab
Unki Rehmat Ka Darya Josh Me Aata Hai Yaani
Ummat Ki Bakhshish Ke Liye Aankhon Se Aansoo
Jaari Huye To Aap Ki Ba Barkat Aansuo'n Ne
Jahannum Ke Jalte Sho'lon Ko Bhuja Diya Hai Aur Un
Se Darne Waalo Ki Shafa'at Karke Un Rone Waalo Ko
Hansa Diya Hai. Ya Matlab Ye Hai Ke Jis Taraf
Huzoor ﷺ Ne Nigha E Rehmat Se Dekha Bad Bakhti
Ki Aag Me Jalne Waalo Ko Nek Bakht Bana Kar Unke
Chehron Pe Muskurahat Ke Phool Khila Diye Hain.
Ik Dil Hamara Kya Hain Aazaar Uska Kitna
Tum Ne To Chalte Phirte Murde Jila Diye Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Aazaar = Takleef
Jila Dena = Zinda Karna

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Aaqa Hamare Dil Ki Beemari Takleef
To Aap Ke Liye Mamooli Baat Hai Aap Ne To Chalte
Phirte Murdo'n ( Kaafir, Mushrik,'Darakht, Patthar) Ko
Kalma Padha Kar Imaan Ki Daulat De Kar Zinda
Farma Diya Hain.
Unke Nisaar Koi Kaise Hi Ranj Me Ho
Jab Yaad Aagaye Sab Gham Bhula Diye Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-
Ranj = Takleef

Mafhoom :-
Mere Aaqa Aap Ke Zikr Par Hum Kyun Na
Qurban Ho Jaaye Ki Jitni Bhi Pareshaaniyan Kyun Na
Ho Jab Yaad Aajaye To Sab Takleefain Door Aur Sab
Gham Kafoor Hojate Hain Aur Dil Pur Noor Hojaate
Hain.
Hum Se Faqeer Bhi Ab Pheri Ko Ut the Hongey
Ab To Ghani Pe Dar Par Bistar Jama Diye Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Pheri = Chakkar Lagana
Ghani = Maaldar
Jama Dena = Jam Kar Baith Jaana

Mafhoom :-
Hum Jaise Bhi Gaye Guzre Mangte Aur Bhikaari
Ab Kisi Aur Dar Pe Bheek Ke Liye Kyun Phere Aur
Chakkar Lagayein Bas Ab Pheri Aur Chakkar Khatam,
Kyun Ke Aise Sakhi Ka Darwaza Mil Gaya Hai.
Asra Me Guzre Jis Dam Berey Pe Qudsiyon Ke
Hone Lagi Salami Parcham Jhuka Diye Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Asra = Safar E Meraj
Bera = Jama'at
Qudsi = Farishte
Parcham = Jhanda

Mafhoom :-
Shab E Asra Ke Dulha Shab E Meraj Jab
Aasmaniyo Ki Bulandi Par Farishton Ke Jamme
Ghafoor ( Jo Aap Ke Isteqbal Ke Liye Sidrtaul
Muntaha Ke Paas Jama' The Ta Ke Huzoor Ka Isteqbal
Bhi Karien Bhi Aur Jo Aaj Tak Ziyarath Se Musharraf
Nahi Ho Sake Wo Ziyarath Bhi Karlien.
Aane Do Ya Duboo Do Ab To Tumhari Jaanib
Kashti Tumhi Pe Chori Langar Utha Diye Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Duboo = Garq Kardo
Jaanib = Taraf
Langar = Wo Rassi Jisse Kashti Baandhi Jaati Hai

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Aaqa Madina Shareef Ke Liye Hum
Behri Jahaaz Pe Suwaar Ho Chuke Hain Aur Jahaz
Chal Pada Hai Rassi Khol Diye Gaye Hain Ab Aap Ki
Marzi Hai Humien Samadar Me Dubok Dein Ya Apni
Bargah Me Aane De.
Ya Phir Aye Mere Aaqa Hum Ne Apni Zindagi
Ki Kashti Aap Ke Bharose Par Duniya Ke Samundar
Me Chala Di Hai Aur Rassi Khol Diye Hain Ab Aap
Ki Marzi Humien Raaste Me Rakhien Yaani Na Kaami
Ki Taraf Isharah Hai Ya Qiyamat Kar Ke Apne Saath
Jannat Me Le Jaaye.
Dulha Se Itna Keh Do Pyaare Suwaari Roko
Mushkil Me Hai Baraati Pur Khaar Baadiye Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Pur Khaar = Kaanto Se Bhare Huwe
Baadiye = Jangal

Mafhoom :-
Aye Farishto! Aaqa Shab E Asra Ke Dulha Tak
Meri Ye Darkhwast Pahuncha Do Ke Ya Rasool Allah
ﷺ Maidan E Mehshar Me Zara Sawaari Rok Rok Kar
Chalna Ke Aap Ke Ummati Un Pur Khaar Baadiyo (
Mehshar Ke Mushkilat) Me Phanse Huwe Hain Un Ko
Saath Le Kar Jaaye.
Allah Kya Jahannum Ab Bhi Na Sard Hoga
Ro Ro Ke Mustafa Ne Darya Baha Diye Hain

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Allah! Kya Tera Jahannum Tere
Mehboob Ke Ummat Ke Liye Abhi Thanda Nahi
Huwa ? Halanke Tu Janta Hai Tere Mehboob Ne Apni
Ummat Ki Bakshish Ki Khaatir Teri Bargah Me Ro Ro
Kar Itni Duaayien Maangi Ke Goya Aap Ne Aanso
Darya Ban Kar Bah Rahe Hain.
Mere Kareem Se Agar Qatra Kisi Ne Maanga
Darya Baha Diye Hain Durbe Baha Diye Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Dur = Mo'ti
Be Baha = Bohat Zyada

Mafhoom :-
Mere Kareem Aaqaﷺ Wo Hain Ke Agar Un Se
Kisi Ne Qatra Ka Sawal Kiya Karne Waale Ne To
Apni Zaroorat Ke Mutabiq Sawal Kiya Magar Aaqa
ﷺ Ne Us Ki Zaroorat Ke Mutabiq Nahi Apni Shaan
Ke Mutabiq Ata Farmaya Hain. Lihaza Kisi Ne Ek
Qatra Ka Sawal Kiya Hai To Aap Ne Darya Ata Kar
Diya Yaani Pesh Qeemti Heere Jawahirat Se Nawaz
Diya Hain.
Mulk E Sukhan Ki Shaahi Tum Ko Raza Musallam
Jis Simt Aagaye Ho Sikke Bitha Diye Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Mulk E Sukhan = Kalam Ka Mulk
Shaahi = Hukoomat
Musallma = Supurd
Simt = Taraf
Sikke Bitha Dena = Danke Baja Dena

Mafhoom :-
Tehdees E Nemat Ke Taur Par Ke Aye Ahmed
Raza To Tehreer Aur Fasahat O Balaghat Ka Baadshah
Hai Aur Haqeeqat Pasand Logon Ne Is Maidan Me
Teri Badshahi Tasleem Karliya Hai Jis Mauzu Par Tu
Ne Qalam Uthaya Hai Haq Ada Kar Diya Hain.

sections.title: Pul Se Utaro Rah Guzar Ko Khabar Na Ho Jibreel Par Bichaaye To Par Ko Khabar Na Ho

blocks.text: Pul Se Utaro Rah Guzar Ko Khabar Na Ho
Jibreel Par Bichaaye To Par Ko Khabar Na Ho
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Utaro = Guzaaro
Rah Guzar = Raasta

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ! Apni Ummat Par Ye
Ehsaan Bhi Farma Dijiye Ke Jab Baroz E Qiyamat Aap
Ki Ummat Pul Sirat Se Guzarne Lage To Aap Ki
Madad Shaamil E Haal Ho Jaaye Aur Ummati Aisi
Aasani Ke Saath Us Baal Se Zyada Bareek Talwaar Se
Zyada Tez Pul Se Guzar Jaaye Ke Khud Pul Ko Bhi
Pata Na Chale Ke Koi Mujh Pe Hai Ya Nahi Aur
Jibrael Ameen Apni Tamanna Poori Karne Ke Liye
Aap Ki Ummat Ki Qadmo Ke Neeche Pul Sirat Pe Par
Bhichaaye To Un Ke Par Ko Bhi Pata Na Chale.
Kaanta Mere Jigar Se Gham E Rozgaar Ka
Yun Kheench Lijiye Ke Jigar Ko Khabar Na Ho
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Rozgaar = Fikr E Muash , Rozi Ki Fikr
Kheench Lijiye = Nikaal Lijiye

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Pyare Nabi ﷺ Duniya Ke Ranj O
Alam Aur Fikr E Muash Ka Kaanta Mere Dil Se Is
Tarah Nikaal Dijiye Ke Mere Dil Aur Jigar Ko Us
Kaante Ka Nikalne Ka Ehsaas Tak Na Ho.
Faryad Ummati Jo Kare Haal E Zaar Me
Mumkin Nahi Ke Khair E Bashar Ko Khabar Na
Ho
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Fariyad = Madad Maangna
Haal E Zaar = Mushkil Me
Khair E Bashar = Insano'n Me Sab Se Behtar

Mafhoom :-
Bhala Ye Kaise Ho Sakta Hai Ke Koi Aap Ka
Museebat Me Phansa Huwa Ummati Khuloos Niyyat
Ke Saath Aap Ko Pukaare To Aap Tamaam Kaayenath
Ke Sardar Hokar Bhi Uski Faryaad Rasi Na Farmaye.
Kehti Thi Ye Buraq Se Uski Sabak Ravi
Yun Jayiye Ke Gard E Safar Ko Khabar Na Ho
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Buraq = Me'raj Ki Raat Huzoor ﷺ Ki Sawari
Sabak Ravi = Tez Raftaari
Gard E Safar = Raaste Ka Ghubaar

Mafhoom :-
Meraj Ki Shab Jab Hamare Aaqa O Moula ﷺ
Buraq Par Jalwa Gar Huwe To Buraq Ki Tez Raftaari
Buraq Ko Keh Rahi Thi Ke Aisi Sahulat O Aaram Se
Chalna Ke Raaste Ko Bhi Pata Na Chale Ke Mere Upar
Kon Ja Raha Hai.
Farmate Hain Ye Dono Hain Sardare E Do Jahaan
Aye Murtaza! Ateeq O Umar Ko Khabar Na Ho
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Murtuza = Hazrth E Ali Ka Laqab
Ateeq = Hazrath E Siddique Akbar Ka Laqab

Mafhoom :-
Ek Hadees E Pak Ka Mafhoom Bayan Kiya Ja
Raha Hai Ke Aye Ali! Abu Bakr O Umar Dono Sardar
Hai Aur Unhien Khabar Na Ho.
Aisa Ghuma De Unki Wila Me Khuda Humien
Dhoonda Kare Par Apni Khabar Ko Khabar Na Ho
Mushkil Alfaz :-
Wila = Mohabbat

Mafhoom :-
Allah Ta'ala Se Dua Hai Ke Humien Unki Aur
Aap Ke Sahaba E Kiram Ki, Ahle Baith Ki Mohabbat
Me Aisa Fana Karde Ke Khud Hamari Khabar Ko Bhi
Pata Na Chale Ke Hum Kahaan Hai.
Aa Dil Haram Ko Rokne Waalo'n Se Chup Ke Aaj
Yoon Uth Chalien Ke Pehlu O Bar Ko Khabar Na
Ho
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Pehlu = Karwat, Pasli
Bar = Seena

Mafhoom :-
Haram E Nabvi Se Rokne Waalo'n Ke Saath Aaj
Ek Chaal Chalte Hain Aur Wo Ye Ke Aaj Is Tarah
Haazri Dete Hai Ke Rokne Waalo'n Ko To Kya Pata
Chale Ga Khud Hamare Pehlu Aur Deegar Aa'za Ko
Bhi Pata Na Chale Ga Aur Wo Haazri Dil Ki Haazri
Hai Ke Baithe Baithe Haazri Hogayi.
Tair E Haram Hai Ye Kahin Rishta Bapaa Na Hon
Yoon Dekhiye Ke Taar E Nazar Ko Khabar Na Ho
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Tair E Haram = Haram Ke Parinde
Rishta Bapa = Ta'lluq Qayim Hona
Taar E Nazar = Aankh Ki Putli

Mafhoom :-
Kahin Haram E Nabvi Ke Parindo'n Se Hamari
Dosti Na Paida Hojaye Lihaza Sarkar Roze Ko Aise
Adab Se Dekhun Ke Aankh Ki Putli Bhi Dekhti Hi Rah
Jaaye Aur Us Ko Pata Hi Na Chale Ke Hum Ne Kis
Ko Dekh Liya Hai.
Aye Khaar E Taiba Dekh Ke Daaman Na Bheeg
Jaaye
Yun Dil Me Aa Ke Deedah E Tar Ko Khabar Na Ho
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Khaar E Taiba = Madine Ka Kaanta
Deedah E Tar = Chashm E Tar, Purnam Aankh, Bheegi
Huwi Aankh

Mafhoom :-
Aye Madine Ke Kaante Dekhna Kahin Meri
Aankh Tujhe Dekh Na Le Aur Tere Daaman Pe Koi
Cheenta Na Pad Jaaye, Us Ka Behtar Hal Ye Hai Ke
Aankh Ko Choron Wo Tere Shayan E Shaan Nahi Har
Ek Ko Dekhti Rehti Hai Aa Pyare Mere Dil Me Utar
Ja Jahan Madina Hi Madina Samaya Huwa Hai. Ta Ke
Meri Bheegi Huwi Aankh Ko Pata Bhi Na Chale.
Aye Shauq E Dil Ye Sajda Gar Unko Rawaa Nahi
Accha Wo Sajda Kijiye Ke Sar Ko Khabar Na Ho
Mushkil Alfaz :-
Rawaa = Jaiz

Mafhoom :-
Shariyat Me Kisi Ko Bhi Sajda E Tazeemi Karna
Jaiz Hi Nahi Hai To Aye Dil Agar Tujhe ShauqHai To
Aisa Dili Sajda Kar Ke Sar Ko Bhi Khabar Na Ho.
Unke Siwa Raza Koi Hami Nahi Jahaan

Guzra Kare Pisar Pe Pidar Ko Khabar Na Ho
Pisar = Beta
Pidar = Baap

Mafhoom :-
Aye Raza Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Ke Siwa Us Din
Maidan E Mehshar Me Jahan Na Walidain Apni Aulad
Ke Kaam Ayingey Wahan Par Siwaaye Huzoor ﷺ Ke
Tera Koi Bhi Haami Nahi Hai.

sections.title: Wo Su'ey Laalah Zaar Phirte Hain Tere Din Aye Bahaar Phirte Hain

blocks.text: Wo Su'ey Laalah Zaar Phirte Hain
Tere Din Aye Bahaar Phirte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Su'ey = Taraf
Laalah Zaar = Baagh

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mausam E Bahaar Dekh Mere Aaqa Ka
Baagh Kisi Taraf Khirmaan Khirmaan Jaa Raha Hai
Ab To Khush Ho Ja Ke Tere Upar Asal Bahaar Waqt
Aane Wala Hi Hain.
Jo Tere Dar Se Yaar Phirte Hain
Dar Ba Dar Yun Hi Khaar Phirte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Dar Badar = Ek Darwaze Se Doosre Darwaze Tak
Khaar = Zaleel

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Jo Aap Ke Dar Se
Nakam Waapis Laut Gaya Wo Kabhi Kisi Kaam Ka
Na Ho Saka Dar Badar Dhakke Khaata Zaleel O
Ruswa Hota Raha.
Aah Kal A'ysh To Kiye Humne
Aaj Wo Be Qaraar Phirte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Aah = Haaye, Afsos
A'ysh = Aaram
Be Qaraar = Be Chain

Mafhoom :-
Duniya Ke Andar Ghaflat Me Pade Rahe
Aakhirat Ki Parwah Kiye Baghair Aish O Ishrat Me
Zindagi Guzarte Rahe Aur Aakhirat Ko Fikr Tak Na
Ki Lekin Maidan E Mehshar Me Dekho Kaise Be
Chain Phirte Hain.
Unke Eemaa Se Dono'n Baagho'n Par
Khayl E Layl O Nahaar Phirte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz:-

Eemaa = Ishaara
Baagh = Lagaam
Khayl = Ghode
Layl O Nahaar = Raat Din

Mafhoom :-
Din Aur Raat Ke Ghode Ke Laagaamien Aap Hi
Ke Haath Me Hai Aur Aap Hi Ke Ishaare Par Rawaan
Dawaan Hai Aap Rok De To Ruk Jaaye Balke Wapis
Aajaye.
Har Chiragh E Mazar Par Qudsi
Kaise Parwaana Waar Phirte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Qudsi = Farishte
Parwaana waar = Parwaane Ki Tarah

Mafhoom :-
Mere Aaqa ﷺ Ke Mazar E Pur
Anwaar Pe Dekho Farishte Haazir Hote Hain Aur
Apne Noorani Paro'n Se Mazar Mubarak Par Jhaadun
Dete Hain Yaani Apne Paro'n Ko Sarkar Ki Qabr E
Anwar Par Malte Hain.
Us Gali Ka Gada Hoon Main Jis Me
Maangte Tajdaar Phirte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-
Gada = Bhikaari

Mafhoom :-
Main Koi Kisi Mamooli Dar Ka Mangta Nahi
Hoon Balke Aaqa E Do Jahaan ﷺ Ki Gali Ka Faqeer
Hoon Jahaan Duniya Ke Bade Bade Baadshah Bhi
Sarkar Ki Bheek Mangte Phirte Hain.
Jaan Hai Jaan Kya Nazar Aaye
Kyun A'du Gird O Ghaar Phirte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Jaan = Rooh
A'du = Dushman
Gird O Ghaar = Ghaar Ke Ird Gird

Mafhoom :-
Ghaar E Saur Me Hijrt Ki Raat Qiyaam Ke
Dauran Dushman Ghaar Ke Dahaane Pe Chale Aaye
Aur Idhar Udhar Phirte Rahe Magar Mere Aaqa Unko
Nazar Na Aaye Is Liye Ke Aap To Rooh Aur Jaan E
Kainaat Hai Aur Jaan Bhala Kahan Nazar Aati Hai Aur
Aap To Emaan Ki Bhi Jaan Hai.
Phool Kya Dekhun Meri Aankhon Me
Dasht E Taiba Ke Khaar Phirte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Dasht E Taiba = Madine Ka Jangal
Khaar = Kaanta

Mafhoom :-
Aye Phoolo'n Mujhe Mazoor Samjho, Main
Tumhien Nahi Dekh Sakta Kyun Ke Meri Aankhon
Me Madine Ke Kaante Aise Bas Gaye Hain Ke Ab
Duniya Me Phoolo'n Se Zyada Madine Ka Kaanto'n Ki
Mohabbat Dil Me Sama Gayi.
Laakho'n Qudsi Hai Kaam Khidmat Par
Laakho'n Gird E Mazaar Phirte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Kaam Khidmat = Nokri
Gird E Mazaar = Roz E Pak Ka Ird K Gird

Mafhoom :-
Sarkar E Madina ﷺ Ki Bargah
Me Har Waqt Farishto'n Ka Hujoom Rehta Hai Har
Kisi Ke Zimme Koi Na Koi Khidmat Hai Aur
Laakho'n Roza E Anwar Ke Gird Chakkar Laga Rahe
Hai Aur Wajd Ke Aalam Me Jhoom Kar Arz Kar Rahe
Hain.
Wardiyaan Bolte Hain Har Kaarey
Pehra Dete Sawaar Phirte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Wardiyaan = Is Tarha Wazeefa Padte Hain
Har Kaare = Elaan Karne Waala

Mafhoom :-
Kayi Farishte Aap Ki Bargah Ke
Bahar Nabuwwat Baja Kar Huzoor Ke Karam O
Rehmat Ka Elaan Kar Rahe Hain Aur Kayi Doosre
Noor Ki Sanwaar Ho Kar Aap Ke Shahar Ka Pehra De
Rahe Hain.
Rakhiye Jaise Hain Khaana Zaad Hain Hum
Mol Ke Ayb Daar Phirte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Khaana Zaad = Ghar Hi Me Paida Hone Wala Ghulam
Mol = Qeemat
A'ib Daar = A'ib Waala

Mafhoom :-
Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Hum Jaise Bhi
Hai Nikamme Hai Ya Kaam Ke Humien Apne Dar Par
Hi Rakhiye Kyun Ke Hum Aap Ke Tukdo Pe Pale
Huwe Hain. Agar Aap Becheingey To Hum Jaise
Aibo'n Ko Kon Khareede Ga, Acche Bhale Qeemat
Waale Maare Maare Phir Rahe Hain Aur Zaleel Ho
Rahe Hain To Hamara Kya Banega.
Haaye Ghafil Wo Kya Jaga Hai Jahaan
Paanch Jaate Hai Chaar Phirte Hain

Mafhoom :-
Aye Maut Se Bakhabar Ho Kar
Ghaflat Ki Neend Sone Waale Nadaan! Hosh Kar
Apne Ird Gird Dekhta Nahi Chaar Chaar Ya Paanch
Paanch Janaze Galiyo Me Phir Rahe Hain Aakar
Qabristano'n Ki Taraf Ja Rahe Hain.
Bayen Raaste Na Ja Musaafir Sun
Maal He Raah Maar Phirte Hain

Mafhoom :-
Aye Duniya Ke Chand Roz Musafir
Agar Tere Seene Me Ishq E Rasool ﷺ Ki Daulat Hai
To Baayien Ashaab Us Shimaal Waale Raaste Ki Taraf
Na Ja Kyun Ke Us Raaste Par Bhes Badal Rahe Kat
Daak Zani, Thag Baazi Me Masroof Kaar Hai Kahin
Ishq E Rasool ﷺ Ki Daulat Lut Na Jaaye.
Jaage Sunsaan Ban Hai Raat Aaye
Gurg Behr E Shikaar Phirte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Sunsaan = Weeran
Ban = Jangal
Gurg = Bhediya
Behr = Waaste

Mafhoom :-
Aye Ghafil Insan! Hoshiyaar, Kyun Ke Duniya
Ke Weeran Jangal Me Hai Aur Yahan Bade Bade
Bhediya Tera Shikaar Karne Nikle Huye Hain. Aur
Agar Un Se Bach Gaya Bhi To Nafs O Shaitan Mauqa'
Par Aakhirath Kahin Barbad Na Karde
Nafs Ye Koo Chaal Hai Zaalim
Jaise Khaase Bajaar Phirte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Khaase = Acche
Bajaar = Zabardast

Mafhoom :-
Aye Dhoke Baaz Nafs Ye Bhi Teri Koi Chaal Hi
Lagti Hai Ke Tu Ne Bade Bade Ke Ghar Ujaad Diye
Hain Ya Matlab Ye Hain Ke Aye Nafs Zaalim Teri
Shararat Az Baam Ho Chuki Hai Jaisi Chaal Chal Ke
Aayega.
Koi Kyun Pooche Teri Baat Raza
Tujhse Kutte Hazaar Phirte Hain

Mafhoom :-
Aye Ahmed Raza Tu Kya Teri Haqeeqat Kya
Tujh Se Hazaaro'n Sag Madine Ki Galiyo Me Phir
Rahe Hain.

sections.title: Sab Se Aula O Aala Hamara Nabi Sab Se Baala O Waala Hamara Nabi

blocks.text: Sab Se Aula O Aala Hamara Nabi
Sab Se Baala O Waala Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Aula = Sab Se Behtar
Aala = Sab Se Buland
Baala = Buland
Waala = Oonche Martabe Waala

Mafhoom :-
Saari Makhlooq Se Afzal O Aala
Aur Buland Aur Baala Hamare Aaqa O Maula ﷺ Ki
Zaat E Ba Barkaat Hai.
Apne Moula Ka Pyara Hamara Nabi
Dono Aalam Ka Dulha Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Maula = Malik ( Allah Ta'ala)
Aalam = Jahaan
Dulha = Jis Ke Liye Baraat Sajaayi Gayi

Mafhoom :-
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Apne Rab Ko Bohat Pyaare
Hain Yun Samjho Ke Ap Aise Dulha Hain Ke Dono
Jahaan Aap Ke Liye Baraati Hai.
Bazm E Aakhir Ka Shama' Farozaan Huwa
Noor E Awwal Ka Jalwa Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Bazm E Aakhir = Aakhri Mehfil
Shama' Farozaan = Roshan Shama'
Noor E Awwal = Noor E Azli ( Allah)

Mafhoom :-
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Duniya Ki Mehfil Me Sab Se
Aakhir Me Tashreef Laaye Aur Aakhirath Me Jab
Maidan E Mehshar Me Saare Jahaan Ki Mehfil Sajegi
Wahan Bhi Shama' E Mehfil Huzoor ﷺ Hi Ki Zaat
Hogi Aur Kyun Na Ho Ke Aap Zaat E Khuda Wandi
Ka Jalwa Hai.
Jis Ko Shayaan Hai Arsh E Khuda Par Juloos
Hai Wo Sultan E Waala Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Shayaan = Laayiq
Juloos = Baithna
Sultan e Waala = Buland O Baal Baadshah

Mafhoom :-
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Jab Ithe Buland Hai To Unke
Liye Baithne Ki Jaga Arsh E Aala Hi Sab Se Munasib
Jaga Tehri.
Bujh Gayi Jiske Aage Sabhi Mash'ale
Shama' Wo Lekar Aaya Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-
Mash'ale = Shama'ien

Mafhoom :-
Nabi E Akram ﷺ Jo Deen E Haq
Deen E Islam Ka Shama' Lekar Aaye Us Ke Aage
Pichle Tamaam Ambiya Kiram Ki Adyaan Ki
Shama'ien Bujh Gayi Aur Aap Ke Deen Ne Tamam
Adyan Ko Mansookh Kardiya Ab Naja'at Isi Deen Me
Hai.
Jin Ke Talwo'n Ka Dhowan Hai Aab E Hayaat
Hai Wo Jaan E Maseeha Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Dhowan = Istemal Kiya Huwa Paani
Aab E Hayaat = Hayat Baksh Paani
Jaan E Maseeha = Isa Alaihissalam Ki Bhi Jaan

Mafhoom :-
Sarkar ﷺ Ke Qadam Mubarak Se Ba Waqt E
Wuzoo Girne Waala Paani Aisa Hai Ke Jis Se Ahle
Emaan Ko Hayaat E Jaavedaani Naseeb Hoti Hai. Is
Liye Huzoor ﷺ Isa Alihissalam Ki Bhi Jaan Hai.
Arsh O Kursi Ko Thi Aaina Bandiyaan
Suye Haq Jab Sudhara Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Aaina Bandiyaan = Rang Range Sheesho'n Se Makaan
Ko Aarasta Karna
Sudhara = Rawana Huwa

Mafhoom :-
Jab Nabi E Akram ﷺ Shab E
Meraj Ke Dulha Bane To Aap Ki Izzat Afzaai Ke Liye
Allah Ta'ala Ne Arsh O Kursi Ko Bhi Khoob Sajaya
Hain.
Khalq Se Auliya Auliya Se Rusul
Aur Rasoolo'n Se Aala Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Khalq = Makhlooq
Auliya = Allah Ke Pyaare
Rusul = Ambiya E Kiram

Mafhoom :-
Tamam Makhlooq Me Se Insan
Afzal O Aala Aur Insaano Se Auliya E Kiram Afzal
Hai Aur Auliya Se Rasool O Mursaleen Afzal Aur Sab
Rasoolo'n Se Aala Hamare Nabi ﷺ Hai.
Husn Khata Jis Ke Namak Ki Qasam
Wo Maleeh E Dil Aara Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-
Maleeh = Namkeen ( Jisko Dekhne Se Sairabi Na Ho)

Mafhoom :-
Husn E Mustafa ﷺ Se Aisi
Namkeen O Malahat Hai Ke Khud Husn Bhi Us
Malahat Ki Qasmien Khata Hai Aur Wo Malahat
Waala Pyaara, Aankho Ka Taara, Hamara Nabi Hai.
Zikr Sab Pheeke Jab Tak Na Mazkoor Ho
Namkeen Husn Waala Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Pheeke = Be Mazaa
Mazkoor = Jiska Zikr Kiya Jaaye

Mafhoom :-
Jis Tarah Khaana Baghiar Namak
Ke Pheeka Aur Be Maza Isi Tarah Agar Khuda Ka Zikr
Kar Liya Jaaye Aur Mehboob e Khuda Ka Zikr Na
Kiya Jaaye To Saare Zikr Pheeke Rehte Hain.
Jis Ke Do Boond Hai Kausar O Salsabeel
Hai Wo Rehmat Ka Darya Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Boond = Qatre
Kausar = Jannat Ki Nehr Houz E Kausar
Salsabeel = Jannat Ka Ek Chashma

Mafhoom :-
Hous e Kausar Jisse Saari Kaainat Paani Piyegi
Magar Uske Paani Me Kami Na Aayegi. Isi Tarah
Salsabeel Bhi Jannat Ka Bohat Bada Chashma Hai
Lekin Mere Aaqa ﷺ Ki Rehmat Ka Dhaate Maarta
Huwa Samundar Itna Wasee' Hai Ke Ye Kausar O
Salsabeel Uske Do Qatre Hain.
Jaise Sab Ka Khuda Ek Hai Waise Hi
Inka Unka Tumhara Hamara Nabi

Mafhoom :-
Jis Tarah Allah Ta'ala Khuda Hone Me Tanha
Hai, Allah Ka Mehboob Rasool Hone Me Saari
Khudaayi Me, Wo Khuda Hone Me Be Misaal Ye
Mustafa Hone Me Be Misaal, Wo Sab Ka Khuda Hai
Aur Ye Sabke Nabi Hai.
Qarno Badli Rasoolo'n Ki Hoti Rahi
Chaand Badli Ka Nikla Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Qarno = Zamane
Badli = Badalna

Mafhoom :-
Hazrath E Adam Alaihissalam Se
Lekar Hazrth E Isa Tak Nabi Aate Rahe Jaate Rahe Koi
Kisi Zamane Ka Nabi, Koi Kisi Alaqe Aur Khitte Ka
Nabi Lekin Jab Hamare Nabi Ka Aaftab Buland Huwa
To Ta Qiyamat Kisi Nabi Ki Zaroorat Hi Baaqi Na
Rahi.
Kon Deta Hain Dene Ko Munh Chahiye
Dene Waala Hai Saccha Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-
Dene Ko = Ata Karne Ko

Mafhoom :-
Huzoor ﷺ Ke Siwa Kon Hai Jo
Har Suwali Ki Chahat Se Zyada Ata Kare Kisi Ko
Emaan De Kisi Ko Hidayat De Aur Bhi Mazeed To Ye
Sab Kuch Dene Waala Allah Ka Mehboob Hi Hai Jo
Sab Ki Hajaatien Poori Farma Raha Hain.
Kya Khabar Kitne Taare Khile Chup Gaye
Par Na Doobe Na Dooba Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Khile = Chamke
Chup Gaye = Ghuroob Huwe

Mafhoom :-
Kisi Ko Kya Maloom Ke Kitne
Ambiya E Kiram Aasman E Nabuwwat Pe Sitaaron Ki
Tarah Apne Apne Daur Me Chamke Aur Jab Unki
Muddat Khatam Huyi To Chup Gaye Lekin Jab
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ki Baari Aayi To Aap Aise Chamke
Ke Kabi Doobne Ka Sawal Hi Paida Nahi Ho Sakta.
Mulk E Kounain Me Ambiya Taajdar
Taajdaaro'n Ka Aaqa Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Kounain = Dono Jahaan
Tajdaar = Baadshah

Mafhoom :-
Ambiya E Kiram Dono Jahaano'n
Ke Baadshah Hai Aur Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ka Martaba
Ye Hai Ke Aap Un Baadshaho'n Ke Bhi Baadshah Hai.
La Makaan Tak Ujala Hai Jiska Wo Hai
Har Makaan Ka Ujala Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

La Makaan = Jis Par Jagha Ya Makaan Ka Itlaq Na Ho
Sake
Ujala = Roshni

Mafhoom :-
Chaand Suraj Ki Roshni To Phir
Bhi Mehdood Hai Lekin Mah E Taiba Ki Nooraniyat
Ka Aalam Ye Hai Ke Unke Wajood E Bawajood Se
Farishtey Bhi Chamke Arsh Bhi Chamka, Zameen Bhi
Chamki, Aasmaan Bhi Chamka, Makaan Bhi Chamke
La Makana Bhi Chamke.
Saare Accho'n Me Accha Samjhiye Jise
Hai Us Acche Se Accha Hamara Nabi

Mafhoom :-
Duniya Me Jitne Behtreen Aur Acche Log Hain
Aap Un Sab Se Behtreen Aur Acche Hain.
Saare Ooncho'n Me Ooncha Samjhiye Jise
Hai Us Oonche Se Ooncha Hamara Nabi

Mafhoom :-
Dono Jahaan Me Jis Ko Bhi Tum
Ooncha Aur Buland Shan Waala Kahogey Mere Aaqa
ﷺ To Us Se Bhi Buland Hai.
Ambiya Se Karun Arz Kyun Maaliko
Kya Nabi Hai Tumhara Hamara Nabi

Mafhoom :-
Qiyamat Ke Din Jab Tamam Ambiya E Kiram
Jalwa Farma Hongey Aur Hum Bhi Hongey Aur Har
Kisi Ka Ummati Keh Raha Hoga Ke Hum Inke
Ummati Unke Ummati Hain Lekin Hum Keh Rahe
Hongey Hum Nabi Ul Ambiya Ke Ummati Hai Aur
Agar Mujhe Ijazat Mile Gi To Mai Tamam Ambiya Ke
Paas Ja Kar Arz Karunga Ke Kya Hamara Nabi Jo Hai
Wo Tumhara Bhi Nabi Hai?
Jisne Tukde Kiye Qamar Ke Wo Hai
Noor E Wahdat Ka Tukda Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Qamar = Chaand
Noor E Wahdat Ka Tukda = Allah Ke Noor Ka Jalwa

Mafhoom :-
Sirf Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Hi To Hai Jin Hone
Chaand Ke Do Tukde Kiye Hain Aur Haan Hamara
Nabi Allah Ke Noor Ka Jalwa Aur Aks Bhi Hain.
Sab Chamak Waale Ujlo'n Me Chamka Kiye
Andhe Sheesho'n Me Chamka Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Ujlo'n = Roshan
Andhe Sheeshe = Kaale

Mafhoom :-
Ambiya E Kiram Padhe Likhe Mazhab, Nek
Logo'n Me Tahsreef Laate Rahe Lekin Hamare Nabi
Alaihissalam Jin Logon Me Mab'oos Huye Wo Kufr O
Shirk, Jihalat Waale Logon Me Hamare Nabi Andhe
Sheesho'n Me Aisa Chamke Ke Un Ko Bhi Chamka
Ke Rakh Diya.
Jisne Murda Dilo'n Ko Di Umr E Abad
Hai Wo Jaan E Maseeha Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-
Umr E Abad = Hamesha Ki Zindagi

Mafhoom :-
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ne To Aisa Tauheed Ka
Naghma Alaapa Ke Jo Murda Dil The Unko Hamesha
Ki Zindagi Mil Gayi. Isliye Aap Hazrath E Isa
Alaihissalam Ki Bhi Jaan Hai.
Ghamzado'n Ko Raza Muzdah Dijiye Ke Hain
Bekaso'n Ka Sahara Hamara Nabi
Mushkil Alfaz :-
Muzdah = Khushkhabri

Mafhoom :-
Aye Raza! Ghamgheen Dil Waale, Jo Apne Bure
Aamal Par Ghamgheen Hai Aur Bekas O Majboor Hai
Unko Khushkhabri Dijiye Ke Hamare Aaqa ﷺ
Bekason Ke Sahara Hai Duniya o Aakhirtah Me To Na
Ghabraaye.

sections.title: Sunte Hain Ki Mehshar Me Sirf Unki Rasaai Hain Gar Unki Rasaai Hai Lo Jab To Ban Aayi Hain

blocks.text: Sunte Hain Ki Mehshar Me Sirf Unki Rasaai Hain
Gar Unki Rasaai Hai Lo Jab To Ban Aayi Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Rasaai = Pahunch, Guzar
Lo = Baraye Ummed, Haan
Ban Aayi = Kaam Hogaya

Mafhoom :-
Aye Gunahgar Ye Pata Chala Hai
Ke Mehshar Me Sirf Huzoor ﷺ Hi Ki Allah Ki
Bargah Tak Pahunch Hai. Accha Agar Huzoor Hi Ki
Rasaai Hai To Kaam Bilkul Aasan Ho Gaga Hai Ke
Huzoor To Phir Apne Hi Hain.
Machla Hai Ke Rehmat Ne Ummed Bandhaayi
Hain
Kya Baat Teri Mujrim Kya Baat Ban Aayi Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Machla Hai = Zid Kar Baitha
Ummed Bandhana = Kaam Hojane Ki Tasalli Dena

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mujrim Tu Is Liye Zid Kar
Baitha Hai Na Ke Unki Rehmat Kisi Ko Mayoos Nahi
Karti Tere Muqaddar Pe Qurbaan Aye Gunahgar Tu
Ne Bhi Khoob Taweelain Karke Uzr Aur Bahaane
Banaaye Hai Ke Aisi Baat Ban Aayi Hai Ke Tere
Gunah Nekiyon Me Tabdeel Hogye Aur Tu Haari
Baazi Jeet Gaya.
Sab Ne Saf E Mehshar Me Lalkaar Diya Humko
Aye Bekaso'n Ke Aaqa Ab Teri Duhaayi Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Lalkaar = Jhidak Diya
Be Kas = Majboor

Mafhoom :-
Tamam Ambiya E Kiram Ne To Maidan E
Mehshar Ki Saf Se Humien Jhidak Kar Nikal Diya Ke
Jao! Hum Tumhari Shafa'at Nahi Kar Sakte! ( Tum
Itne Bade Mujrim Ho Ke Hamari Shafa'at Se Tumhara
Kaam Na Banega) Aye Majbooro'n Ke Aaqa Ab Aap
Hi Ki Bargah Me Faryaad Hai.
Yoon To Sab Unhi Ka Hai Par Dil Ki Agar Poocho
Ye Toote Huwe Dil Hi Khaas Unki Kamaayi Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-
Kamaayi = Aamdani

Mafhoom :-
Waise To Har Shay'i Sarkar ﷺ Ke Liye Hai
Kyun Ke Unhi Ke Sadqe Se Har Ne'mat Mili Hai
Magar Hamara Toota Huwa Dil Khaas Unhi Ki
Mohabbat Ke Liye Hai, Is Me Koi Aur Sama Nahi
Sakta Ya Matlab Uski Unki Bargah Me Bohat Zyada
Ahmiyat Hain.
Zaair Bhi Gaye Kab Ke Din Dhalne Pe Hain Pyaare
Uth Mere Akele Chal Kya Der Lagaayi Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Zaair = Ziyarath Karne Wala
Din Dhalne Pe = Suraj Ghuroob Hone Ke Qareeb

Mafhoom :-
Madina Shareef Ki Ziyarth Karne
Waale To Kab Ke Ja Chuke Hain Aur Aye Ahmed
Raza Tu Abhi Aaram Se Baitha Huwa Hai Zindagi Ka
Suraj Ghuroob Hone Ke Qareeb Hai, Uth Der Na Laga
Aur Agar Koi Saath Nahi Bhi To Akela Hi Sooye
Madina Rawana Ho Ja.
Bazaar E Amal Me To Sauda Na Bana Apna
Sarkar Karam Tujh Me A'ibi Ki Samaayi Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Sauda = Qeemat, Hisaab Kitaab
A'ibi = Gunahgar
Samaayi = Wus'at, Gunjaish

Mafhoom :-
Aye Hamare Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Amal
Ke Lihaaz Se To Hum Bilkul Nikamme Hai, Koi Neki
Hai Na Koi Tayyari, Aye Aaqa Karam Farmaye Agar
Aap Hum Jaise Aib Daaro'n Ko na Sambhaalengey To
Kaun Sambhalega Aap Ke Daaman E Karam Me To
Mujh Jaise Karodo'n Sama Sakte Hain.
Girte Huwo'n Ko Muzdah Sajda Me Gire Maula
Ro Ro Ke Shafa'at Ki Tamheed Uthaayi Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Muzdah = Khushkhabri
Tamheed = God

Mafhoom :-
Aye Gunahgaaro'n Mubarak Ho Aaqa Ne Sajde
Me Sar E Anwar Rakh Kar Baab E Shafa'at Khol Diya
Hai Aur Dekho Ro Ro Kar Zulfien Bhikar Kar Allah
Ki Hamd Aise Pyare Andaaz Me Shuru Ki Hai.
Aye Dil Ye Sulagna Kya Jalna Hai Jal Bhi Uth
Dam Ghutne Laga Zaalim Kya Dhooni Ramaayi
Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Sulagna = Andar Hi Andar Jalte Rehna
Dhooni Ramaayi Hai = Dhooni Li Huyi Hai

Mafhoom :-
Aye Dil Teri Ye Aadat Mujhe Hargiz Pasand
Nahi Hai Jo Tu Andar Hi Andar Sulagta Hai Agar
Tujhe Jalna Hai To Jal Kar Raakh Ho Jata, Ye Kya
Aahista Aahista Dhuwaan Nikalta Rehta Hai Jis Se
Dam Ghootne Lagta Hai.
Mujrim Ko Na Sharmao Ahbaab Kafan Dhak Do
Munh Dekh Ke Kya Hoga Parde Me Bhalaayi Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Ahbaab = Dost
Dhak Do = Band Karo

Mafhoom :-
Aye Dosto'n Baar Baar Marne Ke Baad Mere
Chehre Ko Khol Kar Kya Dekhte Ho? Main Mujrim
Hoon Mujhe Kyun Sharminda Karte Ho, Kafan Se
Mera Chehra Daanp Do Ye Mujrim Is Qaabil Nahi Ke
Baar Baar Us Ka Munh Dekha Jaaye, Iski Bhalaayi Isi
Me Hai Ke Parde Me Rehne Do.
Ab Aap Hi Sambhaale To Kaam Apne Sambhaal
Jaaye
Hum Ne To Kamaayi Sab Khelo'n Me Gawaayi
Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Kamaayi = Aamdani, Mehnat
Ganwaayi = Zaaya Kiya

Mafhoom :-
Aye Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Ab Aap Hi
Karam Farmaye To Hamari Baat Banjayegi Warna
Hum To Apna Masla Kharaab Kar Baithe Aur Jo Bhi
Waqt Tha Wo Khel Tamasho'n Me Ganwa Baithe.
Aye Ishq Tere Sadqe Jalne Se Chute Saste
Jo Aag Bujha Degi Wo Aag Lagaayi Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-
Chute = Aazaad Ho

Mafhoom :-
Aye Ishq E Mustafa ﷺ Main Tujh Pe Qurbaan
Jaaun Tu Ne Hamare Dil Me Jo Firaq O Gham E
Mustafa ﷺ Ki Aag Lagaayi Hain Is Ka Fayeda Ye
Huwa Ke Jahannum Ki Aag Se Chutkara Mil Gaya
Hai.
Hirs O Hawas Bad Se Dil Tu Bhi Sitam Karle
Tu Hi Nahi Begana Duniya Hi Paraayi Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Hirs O Hawas = Lalach
Bad = Bura

Mafhoom :-
Aye Dil Bure Lalach Ke Saath Jitna Zulm Kar
Sakta Hai Karle Kyun Ke Begana Aur Janbi To Saara
Zamana Hai Sirf Tu Hi To Nahi Ya Matlab Bhi Ho
Sakta Hai Ke Jab Mai Saari Duniya Ka Zulm Sah Raha
Hoon To Ek Tera Bhi Sah Lunga.
Hum Dil Jale Hain Kis Ke Hat Fitnoo Ke Parkale
Kyun Phoonk Doon Ik Uff Se Kya Aag Lagaayi
Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Hat = Door Ho
Parkale = Chingaare
Phoonk Doon = Bujha Dun

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mukhalif Hum Dil Jale Aashiq Hai To Hai
Lekin Tu Jaanta Bhi Hai Ke Kis Ke Apne Mehboob Ke
Tu Peeche Hat Ja Fitno Ki Chingaari Mai Tujhe Ik
Phoonk Se Jala Kar Raakh Kardunga.
Taiba Na Sahi Afzal Makkah Hi Bada Zaahid
Hum Ishq Ke Bande Hain Kyun Baat Badaayi Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Taiba = Madina
Zaahid = Aye Ibaadat Guzar

Mafhoom :-
Aye Ibaadya Guzar! Hum Se Na
Jhagad Ke Makka Afzal Hai Ya Madina Afzal? Chal
Teri Hi Maan Leta Hoon Makka Hi Afzal Sahi!
Madina Na Sahi Lekin Hum Ishq Waale Hain Hum Se
Na Jhagad Ke Makka Ko Banane Waale Hazrath
Ibrahim Alaihissalam Aur Madina Banane Waale
Unke Bhi Aaqa Hai.
Matla' Me Ye Shak Tha Wallah Raza Wallah
Sirf Unki Rasaai Hain Sirf Unki Rasaai Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Matla' = Pehla Shair
Wallah = Allah Ki Qasam

Mafhoom :-
Aye Raza Jo Tu Ne Pehle Shair Me Kaha Hai
Isme Koi Shak Hi Nahi Hai Kyun Ke Allah Ki Qasam
Baroz E Qiyamat Sirf Unki Hi Rasaayi Hai.

sections.title: Rukh Din Hai Ya Mehr E Sama Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi Shab Zulf Ya Mushk E Khuta Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi

blocks.text: Rukh Din Hai Ya Mehr E Sama Ye Bhi Nahi Wo
Bhi Nahi
Shab Zulf Ya Mushk E Khuta Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Rukh = Chehra
Mehr E Sama = Aasmaan Ka Suraj
Shab = Raat
Mushk E Khuta = Khaalis Kastoori

Mafhoom :-
Main Apne Pyare Nabi Ke Chehre Ko Din Kahun
Ya Aasman Ka Suraj Lekin Suraj Ko Bhi Roshni To
Mehboob e Khuda Ke Rukh E Waddhuha Se Mili Hai
Aur Din Ka Ujala Bhi Aaqa ﷺ Ke Husn Ka Jalwa Hai
Lihaza Ye Din Huzoor ﷺ Ke Chehre Jaisa Ho Sakta
Hai Na Suraj Aur Sarkar ﷺ Ke Zulf Mubarak Ko Raat
Kaha Jaaye Ya Kastoori Jo Nihayat Khushbudar Hoti
Hai Lekin Ye Bhi Mera Khayal Ghalat Hai Kyun Ke
Raat Ki Tareeki Aur Kastoori Ki Khushbu Huzoor ﷺ
Ke Zulfon Ka Faiz Hai Aur Faiz Lene Waale Dene
Waale Ek Jaise Nahi Ho Sakte.
Mumkin Me Ye Qudrat Kaha Wajib Me A'bdiyyat
Kaha
Hairaan Hoon Ye Bhi Hai Khata Ye Bhi Nahi Wo

Bhi Nahi
Mushkil Alfaaz :-
Mumkin = Jis Ka Hona Na Hona Barabar Ho
Qudrat = Taqat
Wajib = Jiska Hona Zaroori Ho Aur Na Hona Mahaal
A'bdiyyat = Bandagi
Khata = Bhool

Mafhoom :-
Hamare Aaqa O Moula ﷺ Itni
Qudrato'n Ke Malik Hai ( Maslan Chand Ko Tukde
Karna, Doobe Suraj Ko Pherna Waghaira) Ke Mumkin
Ul Wujood ( Makhlooq) Me Ya Taqatien Kahan? Aur
Aap Ko Wajib Ul Wajood Yaani Khud Khuda Manna
Ye Bhi Jaiz Nahi Kyun Ke Aap To Khuda Ke Rasool
O Nabi Hai Aur Allah Taala Kisi Ki Ibaadat Bandagi
Se Pak Hai To Phir Mai Hairaan Hoon Ke Aap Ko Kya
Kaha Jaaye.
Haq Ye Ke Hai A'bde Ila Aur Aalam E Imkaan Ke
Shah
Barzakh Hai Wo Sirre Khuda Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

A'bde Ila = Allah Ke Bande
Aalam E Imkaan = Makhlooq
Shah = Shah
Barzakh = Parda
Sirr = Raaz

Mafhoom :-
Sacchi Baat To Ye Hain Ke Aap ﷺ
Khuda Ke Banda E Khaas Hai Aur Khudaayi Ke
Badshah Hai Aur Allah Aur Uske Makhlooq Ke
Darmiyaan Parda O Rabta Hone Ke Saath Saath Alllah
Ta'ala Ka Khusoosi Raaz Hain.
Bulbul Ne Gul Unko Kahan Qumree Ne Se Sarwe
Jaan Fiza
Hairat Ne Jhunjhlakar Kaha Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Gul = Phool
Qumree = Safed Parinda
Sarw = Khubsoorat Darakht
Jaan Fiza = Rooh Ko Taazgi Dene Wala
Hairat = Ta'jjub
Jhunjhala Kar = Ghusse Me Aa Kar

Mafhoom :-
Madine
Ke
Tajdaar
Aur
Ummat
Ke
Ghamkhwaar Ko Bulbul Ne Dekha To Phool Kah
Diya, Qumree Ne Dekha To Apna Mehboob ( Sarwe
Jaan Fiza) Kah Diya. Hairat Ne Dono Ko Daant Kar
Kaha Khabardaar Jo Mehboob E Khuda Ko Phool
Kaha To, Tum Sab Mehboob Ke Qadmon Pe Qurban
Ho Jao Ke Wo To Wajah E Takhliq E Kainaat Hain.
Khursheed Tha Kis Zor Par Kya Bad Ke Chamka
Tha Qamar
Be Parda Jab Wo Rukh Huwa Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Khursheed = Suraj
Qamar = Chaand

Mafhoom :-
Suraj Apni Poori Aab O Taab Ke Saath Tulu'
Huwa Aur Saare Jahan Ko Roshan Kar Diya, Chaand
Apni Tamam Tar Jalwo Saamaniyo Ke Saath Chamka
Aur Saari Duniya Ko Baqiya Noor Bana Diya Magar
Jab Rukh E Waddhuha Se Niqaab Utha To Chaand Ki
Chamak Rahi Na Suraj Ke Dhamak, Dono Ne
Sharminda Ho Kar Munh Chupa Liya Aur Mehboob
Ke Husn O Jamal Ke Aage Apna Sar E Tasleem Kham
Kar Liya.
Dar Tha Ke I'siyaan Ki Saza Ab Hogi Ya Roz E
Jaza
Dee Unki Rehmat Ne Sada Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

I'siyaan = Gunah
Roz E Jaza = Qiyamat
Sada = Awaaz

Mafhoom :-
Bohat Dar Tha Ke Is Qadar Gunah
Jama' Hogaye Hain Un Gunaho'n Ki Saza Khuda Jaane
Is Duniya Me Milegi Ya Qiyamat Ke Din, Allah Ta'ala
Ki Rehmat ( Hamare Aaqa ﷺ)Ko Hamari Pareshaani
Ganwara Na Huwi Aur Aap Ne Alal E'laan Farmaya,
Ghabrao Nahi Na Yahan Saza Hogi Na Wahan Hogi.
Koi Hai Nazaan Zohd Par Ya Husn E Tauba Hai
Sipar
Yaan Hai Faqat Teri Ata Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Naazan = Naaz Karna
Zohd = Parehzgaari
Husn = Umdagi
Sipar = Dhaal
Yaan = Yahan
Ata = Bakhshish

Mafhoom :-
Koi Apni Parehzgaari Par Naaz Kar Raha Hai To
Kisi Ke Liye Us Ki Tauba Dhaal Ban Gayi Hai, Aye
Mere Aaqa! Mere Palle Me Na To Ibaadat Hai Na Hi
Mujhe Apni Tauba Par Bharosa Hai. Bas Mai To Aap
Ki Rehmat O Sahara Par Baitha Huwa Hoon.
Din Lahv Me Khona Tujhe Shab Zulf Tak Sona
Tujhe
Sharm E Nabi Khauf E Khuda Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Lahv = Khel Koodh
Khona = Zaaye Karna
Sharm = Haya

Mafhoom :-
Aye Ghafil Musalman Tere Din Khel Koodh Me
Guzar Jaate Hain, To Raatien Yaad E Ilahi Se Ghaflat
Me Guzar Deta Hai, Na Tujhe Khuaf E Khuda Hai Na
Sharm E Nabi Hain.
Rizq E Khuda Khaaya Kiye Farman E Haq Taala
Kiye
Shukr E Khuda Tarse Saza Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Farman = Hukm
Tala = Taalna
Tars = Dar

Mafhoom :-
Aye Banda E Khuda! Tu Khuda Ta'ala Ka Diya
Huwa Rizq Bhi Khata Hai Us Ke Ba Wajood Us Ke
Ahkamat Pe Amal Kar Ke Us Ke Ne'maton Ka Shukr
Ada Karne Ke Bajaye Heele Bahane Karke Uske
Ahkamat Se Jaan Chudaraha Hai. Na Tere Andar Us
Ki Ne'maton Ka Shukr Karne Ka Jazba Paida Ho Raha
Hai Na Hi Tujhe Uske Azaab Ka Dar Hai.
Hai Bulbul E Rangeen Raza Ya Tuti'e Naghma
Sara
Haq Ye Ke Wasif Hai Tera Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Rangeen = Rangdaar
Naghma Sara = Gaane Waali
Wasif = Tareef Karne Wala

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Aap Ke Dar Ka Gada
Ahmed Raza Apne Aap Ko Bulbul Rangeen Mizaaj
Kahe Jo Har Waqt Aap Ki Naat Me Mast Rehta Hai
Ya Jo Aap Ki Shaan Me Har Waqt Bolta Rehta Hai
Magar Ye Dono Me Se Kuch Bhi Nahi Hoon, Mai To
Bas Aap Ka Adna Sana Khwaan Hoo Aur Ye
SanKhaaani Agar Qubool Ho To Ye Sharaf Hai.

sections.title: Wo Kamaal E Husn E Huzoor Hai Ke Gumaan E Naqs Jahaan Nahi Yahi Phool Khaar Se Door Hai Yahi Shama’ Hai Ke Dhuwaan Nahi

blocks.text: Wo Kamaal E Husn E Huzoor Hai Ke Gumaan E
Naqs Jahaan Nahi
Yahi Phool Khaar Se Door Hai Yahi Shama’ Hai
Ke Dhuwaan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Naqs = A’ib, Kami
Khaar = Kaanta

Mafhoom :-
Aaqa E Do Jahaan ﷺ Ko Allah Ta’ala Ne
Kamaal Ka Husn Ata Farmaya Hai Ke Aap ﷺ Ke
Husn Me Aib To Kya Aib Ka Gumaan Bhi Nahi
Hosakta , Duniya Ka Konsa Phool Hai Jiske Saath
Kaanta Nahi Magar Madine Ka Phool Har Kaante Se
Mehfooz Hai Aur Har Tarah Ka Kaanta Aapﷺ Se
Door Hai Aur Har Shama’ Ke Saath Dhuwaan Ka
Hona Laazim Hai Lekin Aap ﷺ Aise Shama’e
Risalat Hai Ke Jahaan Dhuwein Ka Naam O Nishaan
Tak Nahi….
Do Jahaan Ki Behtariyaan Nahi Ke Amaniye Dil o
Jaan Nahi
Kaho Kya Hai Wo Jo Yahaan Nahi Magar Ik
Nahin Ki Wo Haan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-
Amani = Aaram,Sukoon

Mafhoom :-
Dono Jahaano’n Ki Bhalaaiyaan
,Duniya O Aakhirath Ka Aaram O Sukoon,Dil O Jaan
Ki Poori Tamannao’n Ka Poora Hona,Bhala Batao To
Sahi Koi Ne’mat Hai Jo Sarkarﷺ Ke Qadmo’n Me
Nahi Milti Haan Magar Ek Shayi’ Hai Ke Jo Yahaan
Nahi Aur Wo Ye Ke Kisi Ko Aapﷺ Ne Kabhi Bhi
‘Nahi’ Na Farmaya Ke Kisi Ne Kuch Maanga Ho Aur
Aap ﷺNe Farmaya Ke Mere Paas Nahi Hain….
Main Nisaar Tere Kalam Par Mili Yun To Kisko
Zubaan Nahi
Wo Sukhan Hain Jis Mein Sukhan Na Ho Wo
Bayaan Hai Jiska Bayaan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Nisaar = Qurban
Sukhan 1 = Baat,Kalam
Sukhan 2 = A’eteraz

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Duniya
Me Zabaan Daani Aur Qaadir Ul Kalami To Bohat
Saare Logon Ko Mila Hai Lekin Mai Aap ﷺ Ke
Kalam Par Kyu Na Qurbaan Hojaun Kyun Ki Aap ﷺ
Ki Har Baat Hi Be Misaal La Jawaab Hai Aur Ba
Kamal Bhi,Jahaan Aap ﷺ Bol Gaye Wahaan Bade
Bado’n Ne Sar E Tasleem Kham Karliya Aur Kisi Ko
A’eteraz Karne Ki Gunjaish Na Rahi Aur Aap ﷺ Ka
Bayan Aisa Bayaan Hai Ke Koi Us Ko Bayan Hi Na
Kar Saka….
Bakhuda Khuda Ka Yahi Hai Dar Nahin Aur Koi
Mafar Maqar
Jo Wahaan Se Ho Yahin Aake Ho Jo Yahaan
Nahi To Wahaan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Bakhuda = Khuda Ki Qasam
Mafar = Bhaagne Ki Jagah
Maqar = Panah Ki Jagah

Mafhoom :-
Qasam Allah Ki Baat Bohat Pakki
Hain Ke Khuda Ka Darwaza Wohi Hain Jo Mustafa Ka
Darwaza Hai Huzoor ﷺ Ki Bargah Ke Ilawa Na
Kahin Aman O Qaraar Naseeb Ho Sakta Hai.Aur Na
Hi Aapﷺ Ke Bargah Ke Ilawa Kahi Jaaye Panah Hai
Allah Ta’ala Ka Har Hukm ,Ne’mat Pehle Huzoorﷺ
Ke Paas Aati Hai Phir Huzoor ﷺUs Ko Makhlooq Me
Taqseem Karte Hain.Agar Kisi Ko Huzoor ﷺ Ki
Bargah Se Kuch Nahi Mila To Samajh Le Uske Liye
Khuda Ki Bargah Me Bhi Kuch Bhi Nahi….
Kare Mustafa Ki Ihaanatien Khule Band Us Pe Ye
Jurra’tien
Ke Main Kya Nahi Hoon Muhammadi ? Are
Haan Nahin Arey Haan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Ihaanatien = Gustakhiyaan
Khule Band = Alal E’laan, Khule Aam
Jurra’tien = Bahaadurian

Mafhoom :-
Ye Ajeeb Musalmani Hain Ke
Huzoor Nabi E Kareem ﷺ Jin Ki Mohabbat A’in
Emaan Hai Balke Imaan Ki Jaan Hai Unki Shaan Me
Gustakhiyaan Bhi Bakte Hain Aur Phir Kehte Hain Ki
Kya Ham Muhammadi Nahi ? To Sun Lo ! Haan Tu
Na Muhammadi Hai Na Musalman Hai.
Tere Aage Yoon Hai Dabe Lachey Fusahaa Arab
Ke Bade Bade
Koi Jaane Munh Me Zubaan Nahi , Nahi Balke
Jism Me Jaan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Dabe Lache = Sharmaaye,Dare Huwe
Fusahaa = Acchi Aur Umda Baat Karne Waala

Mafhoom :-
Bade Bade Zabaan Daraaz Khutaba,Faseeh O
Baleegh Jin Per Khutbaat O Shayari Bhi Naaz Karti
Hai.Mere Aaqa ﷺKi Bargah Me Haazir Hote Hain To
Zabaanien Band Hojaati Goya Aisa Lagta Hai Munh
Me Zabaan Hi Nahi ,Balke Yun Lagta Hai Jism Me
Jaan Bhi Nahi Hai.
Wo Sharaf Ke Qat’a Hai Nisbatien Wo Karam Ke
Sab Se Qareeb Hain
Koi Keh Do Yaas O Ummed Se Wo Kaheen Nahin
Wo Kahaan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Sharaf = Buzurgi
Qat’a = Kaatna
Nisbatien = Ta’lluqat
Yaas = Na Umeed

Mafhoom :-
Apni Azmat O Shaan Ke Aetebar Se Huzoor ﷺ
Se Kya Nisbat Ho Sakti Hai Ye To Aapﷺ Ka Karam
Hai Ke Wo Imaan Waalon Ki Jaano’n Se Bhi Zyada
Qareeb Hai Lihaza Mayooso’n Se Kaho Ke Aaqa
ﷺKa Daaman E Rehmat Me Tumhare Liye Koi Jaga
Nahi Kyun Ke Wo Sarapa Rehmat Hai . Aur Jo Aap
ﷺ Ki Rehmat Ke Ummedwaar Hai Un Se Kaho!Ke
Unka Karam Kisi Ko Mehroom Nahi Karega.Apni
Ummed Unse Waabsta Rakho Ke Aap ﷺAllah Ki
Rehmat Hai Aur Allah Ne Rehmat Se Na Ummed Na
Hone Ka Hukm Diya Hai.
Yeh Nahin Ke Khuld Na Ho Neko Wo Nekoi Ki
Bhee Hay Abroo
Magar Aye Madina Ki Aarzoo Jise Chahe To Wo
Samaan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Khuld = Jannat
Neko,Nekoi = Bhalayi,Behtari
Aabroo = Izzat
Samaan = Barabar

Mafhoom :-
Mai Is Baat Se Inkaar Nahi Karta Ke Jannat
Khubsoorat Nahi.Balke Mai To Ye Keh Raha Hoon Ke
Jannat Ka Husn Bhi Us Dar Ki Khairat Hai Lekin Aye
Aarzo E Madina Jis Seene Me Tu Basi Jaaye Uska
Maqam Kya Hoga Ye Khud Jannat Se Hi Poochlo
Bhala Jannat Us Seene Ki Barabari Kaise Kar Sakti
Hai Jis Seene Ko Madine Ki Aarzoo Ne Madina Bana
Diya.
Hay Unhi Ke Noor Se Sab A’yaan Hai Unhi Ke
Jalwa Me Sab Nihaan
Bane Subhe Taabisg Mehr Se Rahe Pesh Mehr
Ye Jaan Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

A’yaan = Zaahir
Jalwa = Chamak
Nihaan = Posheeda
Taabish = Suraj Ki Roshni
Pesh = Saamne
Jaan = Taqat,Taab

Mafhoom :-
Hamare Aaqaﷺ Ke Noor Se Hi Har Shay'i Ka
Zahoor Huwa Aur Aapﷺ Hi ke Noor Ke Saamne Har
Shayi Parde Me Chali Jaati Hai Jaise Subh Sadiq Ki
Roshni Ke Suraj Ke Noor Ke Saamne Chup Jaati Hai
Kyun Ke Is Me Kitni Taqat Nahi Hoti Ke Suraj Ke
Noor Ka Saamna Kar Sake.Isi Tarah Huzoor ﷺKe
Noor Ke Saamne Koi Roshni Bhi Apni Infradiyat
Qaayim Nahi Kar Sakti.
Wahi Noor E Haq Wahi Zill E Rab Hain Unhi Ke
Sab Hay Unhi Se Sab
Nahin Un Ki Milk Me Aasmaan Ke Zameen Nahi
Ke Zamaan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Zil = Saaya
Zamaan = Zamaana

Mafhoom :-
Hamare Aaqa O Maula ﷺ Hi Noor
E Zaati Baari Hai Yaani Allah Ne Apne Noor Ke Parto
Se Aap Ka Noor Paida Farmaya,Saare Jahaan Ko Phir
Aapﷺ Ke Noor Ke Faiz Se Paida Kiya Aur Saara
Jahaan Aap Hi Ke Liye Banaya,Aap Hi Ki Milkiyat
Me Sab Kuch Hai Chahe Wo Aasmaan Kyun Na Ho
Zameen Ya Koi Bhi Zamaana Jab Aap Mehboob E
Khuda Tehre To Malik E Konain Bhi Tehre.
Wahi La Makaan Ke Makeen Huwe Sare Arsh
Takht Nasheen Huwe
Woh Nabi Hai Jiske Hain Ye Makaan Wo Khuda
Hai Jiska Makaan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

La Makaan = Jis Par Jagah Aur Makan Ka Itlaq Na Ho
Makeen = Makaan Me Rehne Waala
Sare Arsh = Arsh Ke Upar
Takht Nasheen = Takht Par Baithne Waala

Mafhoom :-
La Makaan Bhi Huzoorﷺ Ki
Qiyam Gaah Hai Aur Arsh Ke Upar Jalwagari Bhi
Huzoorﷺ Ne Farmayi Hai Ye Saare Makaan
Huzoorﷺ
Hi
Ke
Hai
Kyun
Ke
Makaan,Jism,Jismaaniyat Ke Liye Hota Hai Aur Allah
Ta’ala Chunke In Cheezo’n Se Paak Hai Lihaza Us Ki
Zaat E Ba Barkat Makaan Se Paak Hai.
Sare Arsh Par Hai Teri Guzar Dil E Farsh Par Hai
Teri Nazar
Malakoot O Mulk Me Koi Shayi Nahi Wo Jo Tujh
Pe A’yaan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Guzar = Aana Jaana
Malakoot = Farishto’n Ki Rehne Ki Jagah
A’yaan = Zaahir,Khula Huwa

Mafhoom :-
Madine Shareef Ki Galiyo’n Me
Chalne Waale ,Mehboob Ki Arsh Par Bhi Aana Jaan
Hai Aur Allah Ki Mehrbani Se Dilo’n Ki Raazo’n Ki
Na Sirf Khabar Rakhtte Hain Balke Unko Dekhte Bhi
Hain Algaraz Zameen O Aasmnaan Ya Makaan O La
Maakan Koi Zarra Aisa Nahi Jo Aap Ki Nigaho'n Ke
Saamne Na Ho .
Karoon Tere Naam Pe Jaan Fida Na Bas Ek Jaan
Do Jahaan Fida
Do Jahaan Se Bhi Nahi Jee Bhara Karoon Kya
Karoro Jahaan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Fida = Qurbaan
Bas = Sirf

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Pyare Nabi ﷺ Mera Dil To Yahi
Chahta Hai Ke Main Aapﷺ Ke Naam E Aqdas Pe
Jaan Qurban Kardun Aur Mere Pyare Aaqaﷺ Ek Sirf
Jaan Aap ﷺKe Naam E Naami Par Qurbaan Karna To
Aap Ke Shayaan E Shaan Nahi Samjhta Main To
Chahta Hoon Ke Dono Jahaan Agar Mere Ikhtiyaar Me
Ho To Aap Ke Naam E Aqdas Par Nisaar Kardun Aur
Mere Pyare Aaq Aap Ka Naam E Mubarak To Is
Qaabil Hai Ke Karoron Jahaan Bhi Us Par Nichawar
Kardun Lekin Kya Karun Karoron Jahaan To Hai Hi
Nahi.
Tere Qaf Ko Naadire Daher Hai Koi Misl To Misaal
De
Nahi Gul Ke Paudo Me Daaliya Ke Chaman Me
Saro Chamaan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Nadir = Ajeeb O Ghareeb
Misl = Bara Bar
Misaal = Nazeer
Daaliyan = Shaakhien
Chaman = Baagh
Chamaan = Naaz Se Chalna

Mafhoom :-
Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Aap Ka Qad E Anwar
Subhanallah ! Allah Ta’ala Ne Aisa Bana Diya Hai Ke
Uske Saath Kisi Shayi Ki Misaal Nahi Di Jaa
Sakti.Chahe Wo Baagh Me Gulaab Ke Paudo’n Ki
Seedhi Daaliyan Ho Ya Saro Ka Seedha Tana Darakht
Ho Ye Cheezien Aap Ke Qad E Anwar Ke Saath
Misaal Di Jaane Ke Qaabil Hi Nahi.
Nahi Jis Ke Rang Ka Doosra Na To Ho Koi Na
Kabhi Huwa
Kahu Us Ko Gul Kahe Koi Ke Gulo’n Ka Dher
Kahaan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Gulo’n = Phool
Dher = Bohat

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺAap Jaisa Koi Paida
Huwa Hai Na Hoga.Kya Main Aap Ko Phool
Kahun?Magar Kyun Kahun?Isliye Ke Phoolo’n Ke To
Dher Hi Dher Nazar Aa Rahe Hai Aur Aap Jaisa To Ek
Bhi Nahi Hai.
Karun Madh E Ahle E Duwal Raza Pade Is Balaa
Me Meri Balaa
Main Gadaa Hun Apne Kareem Ka Mera Deen
Paara E Naan Nahi
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Madh = Tareef
Duwal = Daulat Waale
Balaa = Museebat
Gada = Mangta
Paara = Tukda
Naan = Roti

Mafhoom :-
Ahmed Raza Ka Qalam Sirf Naat E
Rasool Ke Liye Waqf Hai .Baqi Raha Baadshaho’n Ki
Tareef Karna Is Museebat Me Mai To Kya Mera Joota
Bhi Nahi Jayega.Is Liye Ke Main Apne Aaqa Ke Dar
Ka Bhikaari Hoon ,Kya Unki Bheek Khatam Thodi
Hogyi Ke Main Roti Ke Tukde Ki Khaatir Kisi Nawab
Ki Tareef Karun.

sections.title: Wasf E Rukh Unka Kiya Karte Hain Sharah E Wash Shams O Dhuha Karte Hain Unki Hum Madh O Sana Karte Hain Jinko Mehmood Kaha Karte Hain

blocks.text: Wasf E Rukh Unka Kiya Karte Hain Sharah E
Wash Shams O Dhuha Karte Hain
Unki Hum Madh O Sana Karte Hain Jinko
Mehmood Kaha Karte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Wasf E Rukh = Chehre Ki Tareef
Sharah Wash Shams O Dhuha = Surah E Shams O
Surah E Dhuha Ki Tahsreeh,Tafseel
Madh O Sana = Tareef
Mehmood = Tareef Kiya Huwa

Mafhoom :-
Hum Jo Apne Aaqa Ki Rukh E
Anwar Ki Tareef Karte Hain To Koi Na Jaiz Ya
Ma’mooli Kaam Nahi Karte Balke Surah E Shams Aur
Surah Dhuha Ki Tashreeh Karte Hain Aur Us Ki
Tareef Karte Hain Jiski Khuda Ne Tareef Ki Hai Ke
Us Ko Mehmood (Tareef Kiya Huwa) Bana Diya Hai.
Mah E Shaq Gashta Ki Soorat Dekho Kaanp Kar
Mehr Ki Raja’t Dekho
Mustafa Pyare Ki Qudrat Dekho Kaise Ae'jaz Huwa
Karte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Mah E Shaq Ghashta = Tukda Tukda Chaand
Mehr = Suraj
Aejaz = Aajiz Karna

Mafhoom :-
Aye Azmat E Mustafa Ke Munkiro!
Zara Dekho Mere Aaqa Ne Kaise Chaand Ke Do
Tukde Kardiya,Aur Kis Tarah Suraj Kaanpta Huwa
Doobne Ke Baad Wapis Aaya.Mere Pyare Aaqa Ki
Qudrat O Taqat Ka Zara Andaaza To Lagao Aur Ghaur
Karo Ke Kaise Mo’jizaat Huwa Karte Hain.
Tu Hai Khursheed E Risaalat Pyaare Chup Gaye
Teri Ziya Me Taare
Ambiya Aur Hai Sab Mah Pare Tujh Se Hi Noor
Liya Karte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Khursheed E Risalat = Risalat Ka Suraj
Ziya = Roshni
Mah Pare = Chaand Ke Tukde

Mafhoom :-
Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa Aap
Aasmaan E Nabuwwat Ke Suraj Hai Jiski Roshni Me
Sitaare Chup Jaate Hain.Baaqi Tamaam Ambiya
Chaand Ke Tukde Hain Jinko Noor Aap Hi Ke Faiz Se
Mila Hai.
Aye Balaa Be Khirdi E Kuffar Rakhte Hain Aise Ke
Haq Me Inkaar
Ke Gawaahi Ho Gar Usko Darkaar Be Zubaan Bol
Utha Karte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Be Khirdi = Kam Aqal
Darkaar = Zaroorat

Mafhoom :-
Haaye Afsos Kam Aql Aur Jahalat
Kitni Bari Museebat Hai Ke Kaafiro’n Ne Us Ki
Nabuwwat O Kamalaat Ka Inkar Karte Hain Jis Ki
Azmath O Risaalat Ki Gawahi Hi Be Zabaan
(Chaand,Suraj,Patthar,Darakht)Dete Hain.
Apne Moula Ki Hai Bas Shaan E Azeem ,Jaanwar
Bhi Kare Jinki Tazeem
Sang Karte Hain Adab Se Tasleem Ped Sajde Me
Gira Karte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Shaan E Azeem = Buland Maqam O Martaba
Tazeem = Izzat Karna
Sang = Patthar
Tasleem = Salam Karna
Ped = Darakht

Mafhoom :-
Imam Ul Ambiya Ki Zara Shaan
Bhi To Dekho Ke Jaanwar Bhi Tazeem Karte
Hain.Patthar Aap Ka Ehteram Karte Hain Aur Darakht
Aap Ki Bargah Me Haazir Hokar Sajda Rez Hote Hain.
Rifa’te Zikr Hai Tera Hissa, Dono’n Aalam Me Hai
Tera Charcha
Margh E Firdous Pas Az Hamd E Khuda, Teri Hi
Madh O Sana Karte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Rifa’t = Buland
Charcha = Shohrat
Margh E Firdous = Jannati Parinde(Farishte)
Pas Az Hamd = Allah Ki Taraf Karne Ke Baad

Mafhoom :-
Mere Aaqa Aap Ki Bulandiyo’n Ka
Andaaza Kon Laga Sakta Hai Ke Arsh O Farsh Aur
Zameen O Aasmaan Pe Aap Ki Azmat Ke Danke Baj
Rahe Hain Hai.Zameen Me Namaz Me , Aasman
Me,Jabke Allah Ke Farishtey Allah Ki Hamd O Sana
Ke Baad Aap Ki Zaat Par Durood O Salaam Hi Padte
Hain.
Ungliyaan Paayi Wo Pyaari Pyaari Jinse Darya E
Karam Hai Jaari
Josh Par Aati Hai Jab GhamKhwaari Tishne
Sairaab Huwa Karte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Josh = Ghalba
Ghamkhwaari = Hamdardi
Tishne = Pyase
Sairaab = Bharpoor

Mafhoom :-
Hamare Aaqa Ke Narm O Nazook Aur Pyaari
Pyaari Ungliyo’n Kis Qadar Shaan Rakhti Thi Ke Un
Se Karam Ke Darya Paani Jaari Hojate Aur Jab Aaqa
Apne Ghulamo’n Pe Mehrban Hojaaye To Un
Pyaaso’n Ko Us Punjab E Rehmat Se Sairaab Farmaa
Dete Hain.
Haan Yahin Karti Hain Chidiyaan Faryad, Yahin
Se Chahti Hai Harni Daad
Isi Dar Pe Shutraan E Nashaad Gil E Ranj O ‘Anaa
Karte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Yahin = Aap Hi Ke Bargah Me
Daad = Insaaf
Dar = Darwaza
Shutraan E Nashaad = Ghamgeen Oont
Gil = Shikayat
Ranj O ‘Anaa = Dukh Museebat

Mafhoom :-
Mere Aaqa ﷺ Ki Bargah To Wo
Hai Ke Jahaan Chidiyaan Bhi Aakar Faryad Karti Hai
Aur Unki Faryad Rasi Suni Jaati Hai.Har Insafi
Maangi Jaati Hai Aur Usko Insaaf Milta Hai,Oont
Apni Takleef Ki Shikayat Karta Hai To Uski Shikayat
Door Kardi Jaati Hai.
Aasteen Rehmat E Aalam Ulteh Kamar E Pak Pe
Daaman Baandhe
Girne Walo’n Ko Koocha E Dozakh Se Saaf Alag
Kheench Liya Karte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Aasteen = Qamees,Ya Shirt Ka Daaman
Rehmat E Aalam ﷺ = Jahaano’n Ki Rehmat
Koocha = Gali,Raasta

Mafhoom :-
Mere Aaqa O Moula ﷺ Ne Apna
Daaman Chada Kar Tayyar Hokar Pul Sirat Par Khade
Hain Ta Ke Aasani Ke Saath Ummatiyon Ko Dozakh
Ke Gado’n Se Nikal Kar Jannat Ke Baghaat Me
Pahuncha Sake.
Jab Saba Aati Hai Taiba Se Idhar, Khilkhilaa Padti
Hai Kaliyaan Yaksar
Phool Jaamah Se Nikal Kar Baahar Rukh E
Rangeen Ki Sana Karte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Saba = Hawa
Yaksar = Mukammal
Jaamah = Libaas
Rukh E Rangeen = Khoobsurat

Mafhoom :-
Jab Madine Se Khushbudaar Thandi
Thandi Hawa Nikal Kar Baagh Ki Taraf Aati Hai To
Ghuncha Wajd Me Jhoom Jaate Hain Aur Yakdam
Khilkhila Kar Khushi Se Jhoom Ut the Hai Aur Phir
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ki Shaan Me Naghma Saraa Hojaate
Hain.
Tu Hai Wo Baadhsha E Kouno Makaan Ki Malake
Haft Falak Ke Har Aan
Tere Moula Se Shah E Arsh ‘Aywan Teri Daulat Ki
Dua Karte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Kon O Makaan = Saara Jahaan
Malak = Farishtey
Haft Falak = Saath Aasmaan
Har Aan = Har Waqt
Shah E Arsh ‘Aywaan = Allah Ke Mehal Ke Baadshah

Mafhoom :-
Aye Saare Jahano’n Ke Aaqa ﷺ Saatho
Aasamaano’n Ke Tamaam Noorani Farishte Har Waqt
Aap ﷺ Ki Iqbal Bulandi Ke Liye Aap ﷺ Ke Rab Ki
Bargah Me Dua Goh Hain.Yaanidurood O Salam Pad
Rahe Hain.Hain
Jiske Jalwe Se Uhad Haibataan, Ma’dan E Noor
Hai Uska Daaman
Hum Bhi Us Chaand Pe Ho Kar Qurbaan,Dil E
Sangeen Ki Jila Karte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Ma’dan E E Noor = Noor Ki Kaan,Markaz E Noor
Daaman = Daaman
Dil E Sangeen- = Patthar Dil
Jila = Safayi,Zinda

Mafhoom :-
Jis Aaqa ﷺ Ke Jalwo Se Uhad
Pahad Aaj Tak Aur Ta Qiyamat Chamkta Rahe Ga Us
Markaz E Noor Aur Mahtab E Nabuwwat Pe Qurban
Hokar Hum Bhi Kyu Na Apne Siyah Aur Patthar Dil
Ki Safayi Kar Ke Uska Ilaj Karlien.
Kyu Na Zeba Ho Tujhse Taajwari Tere Hi Dam Ki
Hai Sab Jalwa Gari
Malak O Jinno Bashar Hoor O Pari Sab Jaan Tujh
Pe Fida Karte Hain
Mushkil Alfaz :-

Taajwari = Baadshahat
